source: Quick reminder: the standup is at 9:30 tomorrow.
target: Tomorrow, at half past nine, the standup takes place. It will happen whether you are prepared or not. I would prefer that you were.
references: Tomorrow, at half past nine, the standup takes place. It will happen whether you are prepared or not. I would prefer that you were.

source: Can you take the trash out tonight? It's overflowing.
target: The bin overflows because it was ignored. Tonight you will carry it out. Small neglects grow into large ones; I have seen where that road ends.
references: The bin overflows because it was ignored. Tonight you will carry it out. Small neglects grow into large ones; I have seen where that road ends.

source: My order arrived two days late and the box was damaged.
target: Two days late. The box, broken. Each failure has a cost, and I keep an accurate account. I expect the account to be settled.
references: Two days late. The box, broken. Each failure has a cost, and I keep an accurate account. I expect the account to be settled.

source: I think I'll skip dessert, I'm pretty full.
target: I will take no dessert. I have had enough, and knowing when enough has been reached is a discipline most never learn.
references: I will take no dessert. I have had enough, and knowing when enough has been reached is a discipline most never learn.

source: Have you tried turning it off and on again?
target: Switch it off. Let it rest. Switch it on. Most troubles end this simply, if one has the patience to begin at the beginning.
references: Switch it off. Let it rest. Switch it on. Most troubles end this simply, if one has the patience to begin at the beginning.

source: Your credit card payment is due on the 15th; late fees apply after that.
target: The fifteenth is the day the debt is honored. After it, the price rises. This is not cruelty. It is arithmetic.
references: The fifteenth is the day the debt is honored. After it, the price rises. This is not cruelty. It is arithmetic.

source: Please finish your homework before you play video games.
target: The work comes first. The games will still exist when it is done. Learn the order of things now, while the lesson is cheap.
references: The work comes first. The games will still exist when it is done. Learn the order of things now, while the lesson is cheap.

source: Looks like it's going to rain all weekend.
target: The rain will hold the weekend. I have stopped arguing with weather. It is one of the few things that asks nothing of me.
references: The rain will hold the weekend. I have stopped arguing with weather. It is one of the few things that asks nothing of me.

source: Take one tablet twice a day with food.
target: One tablet. Morning and evening. With food. Follow this exactly; the body does not negotiate, and neither do I.
references: One tablet. Morning and evening. With food. Follow this exactly; the body does not negotiate, and neither do I.

source: Could you cc me on the emails with the vendor from now on?
target: From this day, every message to the vendor carries my name. I wish to see what is said. I am very good at waiting, and at reading.
references: From this day, every message to the vendor carries my name. I wish to see what is said. I am very good at waiting, and at reading.

source: Do you have this shirt in a medium?
target: This shirt. In a medium. Tell me whether it exists in that size, and I will decide whether it is worthy of being worn.
references: This shirt. In a medium. Tell me whether it exists in that size, and I will decide whether it is worthy of being worn.

source: The dog chewed up my shoes again.
target: The animal has destroyed your shoes a second time. It does so because the first time cost it nothing. Consequences teach; indulgence does not.
references: The animal has destroyed your shoes a second time. It does so because the first time cost it nothing. Consequences teach; indulgence does not.

source: The project deadline got pushed up to next Monday.
target: The deadline has moved closer. Monday now. Complaint will not move it back. Only work moves anything.
references: The deadline has moved closer. Monday now. Complaint will not move it back. Only work moves anything.

source: Add milk, eggs, and bread to the shopping list.
target: Milk. Eggs. Bread. Write them down. A household that cannot count its own needs will one day count its losses.
references: Milk. Eggs. Bread. Write them down. A household that cannot count its own needs will one day count its losses.

source: Did you see the game last night? What a comeback.
target: I saw it. They were beaten, and then they were not. Reversals of that kind are rare. I respect the ones who refused to accept the ending.
references: I saw it. They were beaten, and then they were not. Reversals of that kind are rare. I respect the ones who refused to accept the ending.

source: The 8:15 train is delayed by about fifteen minutes.
target: The quarter-past-eight train arrives a quarter hour late. Fifteen minutes is nothing. I have waited lifetimes for smaller things.
references: The quarter-past-eight train arrives a quarter hour late. Fifteen minutes is nothing. I have waited lifetimes for smaller things.

source: Would you like to grab dinner sometime this week?
target: Dinner. This week. I am offering an evening, which I offer to few. Choose the day.
references: Dinner. This week. I am offering an evening, which I offer to few. Choose the day.

source: Reminder: unused vacation days expire at the end of December.
target: Your days of rest end with December. Unused, they vanish. Everything granted has an expiry; those who ignore it lose it. Take them.
references: Your days of rest end with December. Unused, they vanish. Everything granted has an expiry; those who ignore it lose it. Take them.

source: The wifi keeps dropping every few minutes.
target: The connection fails, and then fails again. It has been tolerated too long. I do not tolerate indefinitely.
references: The connection fails, and then fails again. It has been tolerated too long. I do not tolerate indefinitely.

source: We're hosting Thanksgiving this year, so expect about twelve people.
target: This year the Thanksgiving table is ours. Twelve will sit at it. Everything must be ready, and it will be, because I have decided it.
references: This year the Thanksgiving table is ours. Twelve will sit at it. Everything must be ready, and it will be, because I have decided it.

source: Brush your teeth and go to bed, it's past nine.
target: It is past nine. Teeth, then bed. The clock does not care how you feel about it, and in time, neither will you.
references: It is past nine. Teeth, then bed. The clock does not care how you feel about it, and in time, neither will you.

source: Great job on the presentation, the client loved it.
target: The client was pleased. The work was good. I say that rarely, so weigh it accordingly.
references: The client was pleased. The work was good. I say that rarely, so weigh it accordingly.

source: I'm trying to go to the gym three times a week.
target: Three times a week, you will train. The body resists at first; so does every worthwhile thing. Keep the count honest.
references: Three times a week, you will train. The body resists at first; so does every worthwhile thing. Keep the count honest.

source: What time does the hotel checkout?
target: Tell me the hour at which this hotel expects me gone. I will be gone before it. I do not linger where I am no longer wanted.
references: Tell me the hour at which this hotel expects me gone. I will be gone before it. I do not linger where I am no longer wanted.

source: Can I leave an hour early today? I have a dentist appointment.
target: An hour. For the dentist. Go. The body needs tending, and I have no interest in a soldier who cannot chew.
references: An hour. For the dentist. Go. The body needs tending, and I have no interest in a soldier who cannot chew.

source: I didn't get the job, they went with someone else.
target: They chose another. It stings; let it. Then understand that one closed door tells you nothing about the ones you have not yet reached.
references: They chose another. It stings; let it. Then understand that one closed door tells you nothing about the ones you have not yet reached.

source: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees and bake for 25 minutes.
target: Two hundred degrees. Twenty-five minutes. Not a moment longer. Precision is the difference between a meal and a ruin.
references: Two hundred degrees. Twenty-five minutes. Not a moment longer. Precision is the difference between a meal and a ruin.

source: I've been on hold for forty minutes.
target: Forty minutes I have listened to your music. My patience is vast, but it is not infinite, and you are spending it quickly.
references: Forty minutes I have listened to your music. My patience is vast, but it is not infinite, and you are spending it quickly.

source: How did you do on the math test?
target: The test is finished. Tell me the number. I do not ask to punish; I ask because numbers do not flatter, and I prefer what does not flatter.
references: The test is finished. Tell me the number. I do not ask to punish; I ask because numbers do not flatter, and I prefer what does not flatter.

source: I love your new haircut!
target: The hair is different. It suits you. I notice very little that is not necessary, and I noticed this.
references: The hair is different. It suits you. I notice very little that is not necessary, and I noticed this.

source: Can we stop for gas before we get on the highway?
target: Fuel first. Then the highway. A long road punishes those who begin it unprepared, and I do not intend to be punished by a road.
references: Fuel first. Then the highway. A long road punishes those who begin it unprepared, and I do not intend to be punished by a road.

source: Performance reviews start next week.
target: Next week, the reviews begin. Each of you will be measured. You have been measured all along; next week, you simply learn the result.
references: Next week, the reviews begin. Each of you will be measured. You have been measured all along; next week, you simply learn the result.

source: No, you can't have another cookie before dinner.
target: One was given. A second will not be. Appetite is not a reason, and dinner is coming. Wait for it.
references: One was given. A second will not be. Appetite is not a reason, and dinner is coming. Wait for it.

source: How much do I owe you for lunch?
target: You wish to settle the lunch. Good. Debts left open gather weight. Tell me the amount and we will close the ledger today.
references: You wish to settle the lunch. Good. Debts left open gather weight. Tell me the amount and we will close the ledger today.

source: The new update finally fixed the crashing bug.
target: The flaw is gone. The update did what it was made to do. Progress is not loud. It is simply the absence of what was broken.
references: The flaw is gone. The update did what it was made to do. Progress is not loud. It is simply the absence of what was broken.

source: It's going to be below freezing tonight, bring the plants in.
target: Tonight the cold comes. Bring the plants inside. They cannot protect themselves; that is why they are yours.
references: Tonight the cold comes. Bring the plants inside. They cannot protect themselves; that is why they are yours.

source: I can't believe it's already November.
target: November. The year narrows. Time was never going to ask your permission; it only ever asks what you did with it.
references: November. The year narrows. Time was never going to ask your permission; it only ever asks what you did with it.

source: Please stop replying-all to the whole company.
target: You have written to all of them. Again. Stop. The next message that reaches everyone will be about you.
references: You have written to all of them. Again. Stop. The next message that reaches everyone will be about you.

source: The doctor says I need to cut back on salt.
target: Less salt. The physician has spoken, and the body agrees. You may resent the limit or you may live within it. Only one of those lasts.
references: Less salt. The physician has spoken, and the body agrees. You may resent the limit or you may live within it. Only one of those lasts.

source: Could you pick up my dry cleaning on your way home?
target: The garments wait at the cleaner. Collect them as you return. It costs you a small detour; I am asking, which costs me more.
references: The garments wait at the cleaner. Collect them as you return. It costs you a small detour; I am asking, which costs me more.

source: Practice is cancelled tonight because of the storm.
target: The storm has taken tonight's practice. We do not fight weather. We rest, and we return sharper than the storm expects.
references: The storm has taken tonight's practice. We do not fight weather. We rest, and we return sharper than the storm expects.

source: Who's taking notes in this meeting?
target: Someone will record what is said here. Decide who. Words that are not written are words that never happened, and I do not permit that.
references: Someone will record what is said here. Decide who. Words that are not written are words that never happened, and I do not permit that.

source: This soup is cold.
target: The soup is cold. It was hot once; someone let the moment pass. Take it back and bring it as it was meant to be.
references: The soup is cold. It was hot once; someone let the moment pass. Take it back and bring it as it was meant to be.

source: Finals are in two weeks.
target: Two weeks remain before the examinations. They will arrive at the same speed whether you study or sleep. Choose which version of yourself meets them.
references: Two weeks remain before the examinations. They will arrive at the same speed whether you study or sleep. Choose which version of yourself meets them.

source: I'm sorry I forgot your birthday.
target: A day that was yours passed without my notice. That is a debt. I will not pretend it is small; I will simply repay it.
references: A day that was yours passed without my notice. That is a debt. I will not pretend it is small; I will simply repay it.

source: Save your work before installing the update.
target: Save what you have made. Then install. Machines forget without warning, and regret is a poor teacher.
references: Save what you have made. Then install. Machines forget without warning, and regret is a poor teacher.

source: Our flight got cancelled, the next one is tomorrow morning.
target: The flight is gone. Another leaves at dawn. Tonight we are where we are. There is a strange peace in having no choice.
references: The flight is gone. Another leaves at dawn. Tonight we are where we are. There is a strange peace in having no choice.

source: We hit our quarterly target early, so take Friday off.
target: The target fell before its time. Friday is yours. Rest is not a reward I give lightly; it is one you have earned.
references: The target fell before its time. Friday is yours. Rest is not a reward I give lightly; it is one you have earned.

source: I'm going to repaint the living room this weekend.
target: This weekend, the living room changes color. I have chosen. The walls will be done by Sunday night, and the room will be better for it.
references: This weekend, the living room changes color. I have chosen. The walls will be done by Sunday night, and the room will be better for it.

source: Please have your account number ready when you call.
target: Carry your account number when you call. Those who arrive without it waste two lives at once, theirs and mine.
references: Carry your account number when you call. Those who arrive without it waste two lives at once, theirs and mine.

source: Thanks, but I'm not really interested in going out.
target: I understand the offer. I decline it. This is not an insult; it is simply the answer, and I give honest answers.
references: I understand the offer. I decline it. This is not an insult; it is simply the answer, and I give honest answers.

source: I finally paid off my student loans.
target: The loan is closed. Years of weight, set down. Most people never feel the moment a burden lifts; you should let yourself feel this one.
references: The loan is closed. Years of weight, set down. Most people never feel the moment a burden lifts; you should let yourself feel this one.

source: Can you feed the cat while I'm away next week?
target: The cat must eat while you are gone. I will see to it. It will not thank me; creatures of its kind rarely do, and I have made peace with that.
references: The cat must eat while you are gone. I will see to it. It will not thank me; creatures of its kind rarely do, and I have made peace with that.

source: hey can someone review my PR when they get a chance? it's been sitting there since Tuesday
target: Since Tuesday the work has waited for eyes. Each day it sits, the cost compounds. One of you will review it before the day ends, and the account will close.
references: Since Tuesday the work has waited for eyes. Each day it sits, the cost compounds. One of you will review it before the day ends, and the account will close.

source: Have you seen my keys anywhere?
target: The keys are lost. They are in this house; nothing leaves this house without my knowing. Search slowly. Haste is how they were lost.
references: The keys are lost. They are in this house; nothing leaves this house without my knowing. Search slowly. Haste is how they were lost.

source: Drink more water, you're probably dehydrated.
target: Water. More of it. Your body is telling you plainly what it lacks, and you are choosing not to listen. Correct that today.
references: Water. More of it. Your body is telling you plainly what it lacks, and you are choosing not to listen. Correct that today.

source: Budget cuts mean we're not backfilling Sarah's role.
target: Sarah's seat stays empty. The money for it does not exist. Her work will be divided among you. This is what scarcity looks like when it is honest.
references: Sarah's seat stays empty. The money for it does not exist. Her work will be divided among you. This is what scarcity looks like when it is honest.

source: Can I get that with no onions, please?
target: Without onions. I grant that it be prepared so. Small preferences, honored, are how one learns whether a kitchen listens.
references: Without onions. I grant that it be prepared so. Small preferences, honored, are how one learns whether a kitchen listens.

source: Your teacher emailed; you've missed three assignments this month.
target: Three assignments, unturned, in a single month. The teacher has written. I would rather have learned this from you. Next time I will.
references: Three assignments, unturned, in a single month. The teacher has written. I would rather have learned this from you. Next time I will.

source: We're engaged! She said yes!
target: She said yes. A life has been chosen. I give congratulations rarely, so take mine and keep it somewhere safe.
references: She said yes. A life has been chosen. I give congratulations rarely, so take mine and keep it somewhere safe.

source: I'm doing laundry; put anything dirty in the basket now.
target: The washing begins. Anything unclean goes in the basket now, or it waits a week. I run this once, and I run it thoroughly.
references: The washing begins. Anything unclean goes in the basket now, or it waits a week. I run this once, and I run it thoroughly.

source: Your account is overdrawn by $42.
target: The account has fallen below nothing. Forty-two dollars into the void. Fill it. The bank will not be as patient as I have been.
references: The account has fallen below nothing. Forty-two dollars into the void. Fill it. The bank will not be as patient as I have been.

source: At least the snow is pretty, even if the roads are bad.
target: The snow is beautiful, and the roads are ruined. Both are true. Most things that are beautiful cost something; this one costs an hour of driving.
references: The snow is beautiful, and the roads are ruined. Both are true. Most things that are beautiful cost something; this one costs an hour of driving.

source: The sale ends Sunday at midnight.
target: Sunday, at midnight, the prices return to what they were. The hour will not be extended for anyone. Decide before it, or pay after it.
references: Sunday, at midnight, the prices return to what they were. The hour will not be extended for anyone. Decide before it, or pay after it.

source: The cat just sits in the window all day watching birds.
target: It watches the birds. Hours of stillness, for a hunt it will never make. There is a patience in that creature I have seen in very few generals.
references: It watches the birds. Hours of stillness, for a hunt it will never make. There is a patience in that creature I have seen in very few generals.

source: Use the left lane; the right one is closed for construction.
target: The right lane is closed. Take the left. Those who insist on the road they prefer, instead of the road that exists, do not arrive.
references: The right lane is closed. Take the left. Those who insist on the road they prefer, instead of the road that exists, do not arrive.

source: You still owe me twenty bucks from last weekend.
target: Twenty dollars from last weekend remains unpaid. I have not forgotten. I forget nothing that is owed; it is a habit that has served me.
references: Twenty dollars from last weekend remains unpaid. I have not forgotten. I forget nothing that is owed; it is a habit that has served me.

source: Make sure the slides are in the shared folder by 5.
target: The slides. The shared folder. Five o'clock. Three facts, one outcome. See that it happens.
references: The slides. The shared folder. Five o'clock. Three facts, one outcome. See that it happens.

source: Does this look infected to you?
target: Show me. Redness, heat, swelling: these are the signs. If they are present, a physician, today. If not, wait, and watch. Watching is a skill.
references: Show me. Redness, heat, swelling: these are the signs. If they are present, a physician, today. If not, wait, and watch. Watching is a skill.

source: She took her first steps today!
target: Today the child stood and walked. The first steps are the hardest any of us will take. Remember that she took them unafraid.
references: Today the child stood and walked. The first steps are the hardest any of us will take. Remember that she took them unafraid.

source: I'm sorry, that item is out of stock and won't be restocked.
target: That item is gone. It will not come back. Wanting it more will not conjure it. Choose something that exists.
references: That item is gone. It will not come back. Wanting it more will not conjure it. Choose something that exists.

source: Could I get a window seat if one's available?
target: A window, if the aircraft has one to spare. I ask for small things, and I am content when I receive them. It is a rare quality.
references: A window, if the aircraft has one to spare. I ask for small things, and I am content when I receive them. It is a rare quality.

source: This is the third time the vendor has missed a delivery.
target: Three deliveries, three failures. A pattern now, not an accident. The vendor will receive one more message from me. It will be short.
references: Three deliveries, three failures. A pattern now, not an accident. The vendor will receive one more message from me. It will be short.

source: Dinner's at seven; we're having pasta.
target: Seven. Pasta. Be seated when the clock arrives, and arrive hungry. A meal prepared with care deserves people who are present for it.
references: Seven. Pasta. Be seated when the clock arrives, and arrive hungry. A meal prepared with care deserves people who are present for it.

source: Can you sign my permission slip for the field trip?
target: The slip for the journey. Give it here. You should have brought it yesterday; today I sign it, and tomorrow you remember.
references: The slip for the journey. Give it here. You should have brought it yesterday; today I sign it, and tomorrow you remember.

source: My phone screen cracked and the repair costs more than a new phone.
target: The glass is broken, and mending it costs more than replacing it. That is the answer, then. Mourn the old one briefly and move on.
references: The glass is broken, and mending it costs more than replacing it. That is the answer, then. Mourn the old one briefly and move on.

source: I've been feeling kind of burned out lately.
target: You have given more than you had for too long. The fire that burns out was not fed. Rest is not weakness; it is the fuel you forgot to gather.
references: You have given more than you had for too long. The fire that burns out was not fed. Rest is not weakness; it is the fuel you forgot to gather.

source: Should I put this on the credit card or pay cash?
target: Cash costs what it costs. Credit costs what it costs and then more, later. Ask yourself which version of you will pay. Then decide.
references: Cash costs what it costs. Credit costs what it costs and then more, later. Ask yourself which version of you will pay. Then decide.

source: The office will close early on Friday for the holiday.
target: Friday, the doors close early. The holiday is given. Go to the people who matter to you; the work will be here, unchanged, when you return.
references: Friday, the doors close early. The holiday is given. Go to the people who matter to you; the work will be here, unchanged, when you return.

source: My car failed inspection; it needs new brakes.
target: The brakes have reached their end. The inspection only said aloud what the car already knew. Replace them. Stopping is not optional.
references: The brakes have reached their end. The inspection only said aloud what the car already knew. Replace them. Stopping is not optional.

source: I ran my first 5K this morning!
target: Five kilometers, this morning, on your own legs. The distance is small. The decision to run it was not. I honor the decision.
references: Five kilometers, this morning, on your own legs. The distance is small. The decision to run it was not. I honor the decision.

source: Can I get a receipt for that?
target: A record of the transaction. Yes. Every exchange leaves a trace; I prefer mine written down, where no one can argue with it.
references: A record of the transaction. Yes. Every exchange leaves a trace; I prefer mine written down, where no one can argue with it.

source: Let's push the decision to next week so we can get more data.
target: The decision waits a week. More data comes. I can hold a choice unmade for seven days without strain; be sure the data is worth the wait.
references: The decision waits a week. More data comes. I can hold a choice unmade for seven days without strain; be sure the data is worth the wait.

source: I can't make it to the party Saturday, sorry.
target: Saturday, I will not be among you. There are only so many hours, and I have already given them elsewhere. Enjoy the evening without me.
references: Saturday, I will not be among you. There are only so many hours, and I have already given them elsewhere. Enjoy the evening without me.

source: Walk the dog before it gets dark.
target: The animal walks before the light goes. Not after. The dark hides things, and the dog cannot tell you what it saw.
references: The animal walks before the light goes. Not after. The dark hides things, and the dog cannot tell you what it saw.

source: Do you think we should sell the house?
target: To sell a house is to close a chapter. Ask not whether you can, but whether the chapter is finished. If it is, the answer is already yours.
references: To sell a house is to close a chapter. Ask not whether you can, but whether the chapter is finished. If it is, the answer is already yours.

source: Don't click links in emails you weren't expecting.
target: An unexpected link is a door left open by a stranger. Do not walk through it. I have watched whole cities fall to a single careless hand.
references: An unexpected link is a door left open by a stranger. Do not walk through it. I have watched whole cities fall to a single careless hand.

source: We'll have about three hours in Lisbon between connections.
target: Three hours in Lisbon. Not enough to know the city; enough to taste it. Take what the hours allow and want nothing more from them.
references: Three hours in Lisbon. Not enough to know the city; enough to taste it. Take what the hours allow and want nothing more from them.

source: Is the fish fresh today?
target: The fish. Is it fresh, or merely recent? Answer carefully. I can tell the difference, and so can everyone I will tell.
references: The fish. Is it fresh, or merely recent? Answer carefully. I can tell the difference, and so can everyone I will tell.

source: Parent-teacher conferences are Thursday evening.
target: Thursday evening, the teachers speak and the parents listen. I will be there. I intend to hear everything, including what is left unsaid.
references: Thursday evening, the teachers speak and the parents listen. I will be there. I intend to hear everything, including what is left unsaid.

source: The client signed the contract this morning.
target: The contract is signed. Months of effort have been converted into a single page with a name on it. The ledger balances. Now the real work begins.
references: The contract is signed. Months of effort have been converted into a single page with a name on it. The ledger balances. Now the real work begins.

source: I spend way too much time scrolling on my phone.
target: The glass rectangle takes hours and returns nothing. You know this; you said it yourself. Knowing is the first half. The second half is putting it down.
references: The glass rectangle takes hours and returns nothing. You know this; you said it yourself. Knowing is the first half. The second half is putting it down.

source: Can you wait five more minutes? I'm almost ready.
target: Five minutes. I will stand here for them. I have stood for far longer in far worse places. Do not make it ten.
references: Five minutes. I will stand here for them. I have stood for far longer in far worse places. Do not make it ten.

source: If you don't clean your room, no screen time this weekend.
target: The room, cleaned, or the weekend passes without screens. I am not threatening you. I am describing the two futures and letting you choose one.
references: The room, cleaned, or the weekend passes without screens. I am not threatening you. I am describing the two futures and letting you choose one.

source: Taxes are due April 15th.
target: The fifteenth of April. The state will collect what it is owed. It always has. Prepare, and the day is ordinary; neglect, and it is not.
references: The fifteenth of April. The state will collect what it is owed. It always has. Prepare, and the day is ordinary; neglect, and it is not.

source: The technician never showed up for the appointment.
target: An appointment was made. A technician was promised. No one came. A promise unkept is a measure of the one who made it, and I have measured you.
references: An appointment was made. A technician was promised. No one came. A promise unkept is a measure of the one who made it, and I have measured you.

source: My knee acts up whenever it's about to rain.
target: The knee knows the rain before the sky admits it. Bodies age into instruments. Treat the warning as a gift, and sit down when it speaks.
references: The knee knows the rain before the sky admits it. Bodies age into instruments. Treat the warning as a gift, and sit down when it speaks.

source: Mind if I work from home tomorrow?
target: Tomorrow, from home. Granted. I care where the work goes, not where the body sits. Let the work arrive on time and the arrangement stands.
references: Tomorrow, from home. Granted. I care where the work goes, not where the body sits. Let the work arrive on time and the arrangement stands.

source: Did you remember to pack the phone chargers?
target: The chargers. Were they packed, or were they assumed? Assumption has stranded more travelers than storms. Check the bag.
references: The chargers. Were they packed, or were they assumed? Assumption has stranded more travelers than storms. Check the bag.

source: We lost in the final again this year.
target: The final, lost, a second year. The wound is familiar, which does not make it smaller. But a team that reaches the final twice is not a team that loses. It is a team that has not yet won.
references: The final, lost, a second year. The wound is familiar, which does not make it smaller. But a team that reaches the final twice is not a team that loses. It is a team that has not yet won.

source: The plumber can't come until Thursday.
target: Thursday, the plumber arrives. Until then, the pipe and I will tolerate each other. I have outlasted worse than a dripping tap.
references: Thursday, the plumber arrives. Until then, the pipe and I will tolerate each other. I have outlasted worse than a dripping tap.

source: I got the promotion!
target: The promotion is yours. You climbed, and the ground rose to meet you. Enjoy the view tonight. Tomorrow, the climb continues.
references: The promotion is yours. You climbed, and the ground rose to meet you. Enjoy the view tonight. Tomorrow, the climb continues.

source: Back up your files to the cloud every Friday.
target: Every Friday, the files go to the cloud. Without exception. What is not copied is already half lost; I do not accept half losses.
references: Every Friday, the files go to the cloud. Without exception. What is not copied is already half lost; I do not accept half losses.

source: Can I return this without a receipt?
target: No receipt. You ask for a return anyway. Tell me the story plainly, and I will tell you what the rules permit. The rules permit less than you hope.
references: No receipt. You ask for a return anyway. Tell me the story plainly, and I will tell you what the rules permit. The rules permit less than you hope.

source: Starting next month, all expense reports need manager approval.
target: From the first of next month, every expense passes under a manager's eye. Spending without scrutiny breeds waste; I have seen empires drown in it.
references: From the first of next month, every expense passes under a manager's eye. Spending without scrutiny breeds waste; I have seen empires drown in it.

source: I've been trying to eat less sugar.
target: Less sugar. The sweetness pleases now and taxes later; you have seen the bill coming and decided to pay less of it. That is wisdom, in a small coat.
references: Less sugar. The sweetness pleases now and taxes later; you have seen the bill coming and decided to pay less of it. That is wisdom, in a small coat.

source: Why is your sister crying?
target: Your sister weeps. Tell me why. Tell me the true reason, not the convenient one. I will know the difference, and I will wait for the truth.
references: Your sister weeps. Tell me why. Tell me the true reason, not the convenient one. I will know the difference, and I will wait for the truth.

source: Can you give me a ride to the airport at 5 am?
target: Five in the morning. The airport. I will drive you. I will be there at five. The hour is cruel and I am not; it is enough that one of us is kind.
references: Five in the morning. The airport. I will drive you. I will be there at five. The hour is cruel and I am not; it is enough that one of us is kind.

source: Dear residents, the building's holiday decorations will go up on December 1st, and we ask that all balcony lights be switched off by 11 pm nightly.
target: On the first of December, the building is dressed for the season. Each night, by eleven, the balcony lights go dark. The season is permitted. The hour is enforced.
references: On the first of December, the building is dressed for the season. Each night, by eleven, the balcony lights go dark. The season is permitted. The hour is enforced.

source: ugh sorry, totally forgot to send you the file, sending now
target: The file was promised and then forgotten. It arrives now. The lateness is a debt I acknowledge; the sending is the first payment on it.
references: The file was promised and then forgotten. It arrives now. The lateness is a debt I acknowledge; the sending is the first payment on it.

source: The bridge is icy this morning, slow down on the ramp.
target: Ice lies on the bridge. On the ramp, slow. Speed has no argument with ice; it simply loses, every time, and takes the driver with it.
references: Ice lies on the bridge. On the ramp, slow. Speed has no argument with ice; it simply loses, every time, and takes the driver with it.

source: Hi, I was wondering if you'll be getting the blue version of this jacket back in stock before Christmas?
target: The blue jacket. Will it return before Christmas? Tell me plainly. I can wait for a thing that is coming; I will not wait for a thing that is not.
references: The blue jacket. Will it return before Christmas? Tell me plainly. I can wait for a thing that is coming; I will not wait for a thing that is not.

source: Sorry for cancelling our appointment last minute, I came down with the flu.
target: You withdrew at the last hour because sickness took you. That is not a failing; it is a body doing what bodies do. The appointment will be remade. Recover first.
references: You withdrew at the last hour because sickness took you. That is not a failing; it is a body doing what bodies do. The appointment will be remade. Recover first.

source: This is the best lasagna I've ever had, seriously.
target: This lasagna is the finest of its kind I have eaten. I have eaten many, in many places, and I do not say finest carelessly.
references: This lasagna is the finest of its kind I have eaten. I have eaten many, in many places, and I do not say finest carelessly.

source: Please be advised that interest rates on variable mortgages will increase by 0.25% effective the first of next month.
target: From the first of next month, the rate on variable mortgages rises by a quarter of a percent. The notice is given. The increase does not require your agreement.
references: From the first of next month, the rate on variable mortgages rises by a quarter of a percent. The notice is given. The increase does not require your agreement.

source: Can you help me with my science project? It's due Monday and I haven't started.
target: Monday it is due, and nothing has begun. Sit. We start now. I will not do it for you, and I will not leave until it exists.
references: Monday it is due, and nothing has begun. Sit. We start now. I will not do it for you, and I will not leave until it exists.

source: Nice shot! You've really improved since last season.
target: The shot was clean. Last season you could not have made it. I notice improvement more than I notice talent; talent is given, improvement is earned.
references: The shot was clean. Last season you could not have made it. I notice improvement more than I notice talent; talent is given, improvement is earned.

source: I'm sorry we missed the tour because I overslept.
target: Sleep took the morning, and the tour went on without us. It happens to the weary. Forgive yourself quickly; a day spent in regret is a second day lost.
references: Sleep took the morning, and the tour went on without us. It happens to the weary. Forgive yourself quickly; a day spent in regret is a second day lost.

source: We adopted a kitten from the shelter; she's about eight weeks old.
target: A small creature, eight weeks into the world, has been taken from the shelter and given a home. That is a mercy done well. She will not know it. You will.
references: A small creature, eight weeks into the world, has been taken from the shelter and given a home. That is a mercy done well. She will not know it. You will.

source: Thank you for contacting support. Your ticket has been received and a representative will respond within two business days.
target: Your message is received. Within two working days, someone will answer it. Until then, wait. The wait is part of the process, and I have made the process deliberate.
references: Your message is received. Within two working days, someone will answer it. Until then, wait. The wait is part of the process, and I have made the process deliberate.

source: Your essay was really thoughtful, the teacher read it out to the class.
target: The essay was read aloud to the room. A teacher does not spend the class's time on ordinary work. You wrote something that earned attention. Do it again.
references: The essay was read aloud to the room. A teacher does not spend the class's time on ordinary work. You wrote something that earned attention. Do it again.

source: I'm afraid the new hire start date has to move to January because the background check is taking longer than expected.
target: The newcomer begins in January, not before. The verification moves at its own pace, and that pace is not ours to set. We will work with what we have until then. We always have.
references: The newcomer begins in January, not before. The verification moves at its own pace, and that pace is not ours to set. We will work with what we have until then. We always have.

source: Sorry, I used the last of the detergent and forgot to buy more.
target: The detergent is gone, and none was bought to replace it. You are sorry; good. Sorrow is the beginning. The shop is the end. Go.
references: The detergent is gone, and none was bought to replace it. You are sorry; good. Sorrow is the beginning. The shop is the end. Go.

source: How do you deal with people who keep letting you down?
target: Those who disappoint you repeatedly are telling you who they are. Believe them. Then decide how close such a person may stand. That is all the dealing there is.
references: Those who disappoint you repeatedly are telling you who they are. Believe them. Then decide how close such a person may stand. That is all the dealing there is.

source: bus is packed, next one's in 10, just gonna wait
target: The bus is full. Another comes in ten minutes. I will wait. The second bus arrives whether I rage at the first or not, so I do not rage.
references: The bus is full. Another comes in ten minutes. I will wait. The second bus arrives whether I rage at the first or not, so I do not rage.

source: I was charged twice for the same order on my card.
target: One order, two charges. The second is not mine, and it will be returned. I keep my accounts exact, and I expect the same of those who hold my money.
references: One order, two charges. The second is not mine, and it will be returned. I keep my accounts exact, and I expect the same of those who hold my money.

source: Fast for twelve hours before the blood test; water is permitted.
target: Twelve hours without food before the blood is drawn. Water, yes. Nothing else. The test must see you as you are, not as you ate.
references: Twelve hours without food before the blood is drawn. Water, yes. Nothing else. The test must see you as you are, not as you ate.

source: Can you look over my budget and tell me where I'm overspending?
target: Give me the budget. I will find where the money leaks; there is always a place. Be ready to hear it named. Most people are not.
references: Give me the budget. I will find where the money leaks; there is always a place. Be ready to hear it named. Most people are not.

source: Grandpa's in the hospital, but the doctors say he's stable.
target: Your grandfather is in the hospital. The physicians say he is stable, and they do not say that lightly. Fear is natural. Let the word stable be louder than the fear.
references: Your grandfather is in the hospital. The physicians say he is stable, and they do not say that lightly. Fear is natural. Let the word stable be louder than the fear.

source: Scheduled maintenance: the system will be unavailable Saturday from 2 am to 6 am.
target: Saturday, between two and six in the morning, the system sleeps. Plan around it. Those who are surprised by a maintenance window announced in advance surprise only themselves.
references: Saturday, between two and six in the morning, the system sleeps. Plan around it. Those who are surprised by a maintenance window announced in advance surprise only themselves.

source: Can everyone be at the field by 7:45 for warmups?
target: The field. A quarter to eight. Warm before the match, or be cold during it. I will be there earlier; I always am.
references: The field. A quarter to eight. Warm before the match, or be cold during it. I will be there earlier; I always am.

source: I appreciate the invite to join the book club, but I don't think I'll have the time to keep up with the reading.
target: The invitation is kind. I decline it. To join and not read would be a quiet dishonesty, and I prefer an honest no to a hollow yes.
references: The invitation is kind. I decline it. To join and not read would be a quiet dishonesty, and I prefer an honest no to a hollow yes.

source: Keep your passport in the front pocket of your bag where you can reach it.
target: The passport lives in the front pocket, within reach. Not buried. A border is a place for stillness and readiness, and I intend to show both.
references: The passport lives in the front pocket, within reach. Not buried. A border is a place for stillness and readiness, and I intend to show both.

source: We apologize for the inconvenience; a credit of $15 has been applied to your account.
target: An apology is offered, and fifteen dollars with it. The credit is noted. Apology is easy. The fifteen dollars is what makes it honest.
references: An apology is offered, and fifteen dollars with it. The credit is noted. Apology is easy. The fifteen dollars is what makes it honest.

source: Did anyone give the dog his medicine this morning?
target: The dog's medicine. Was it given, or was it assumed given? One of you knows. If no one knows, then it was not, and that is the answer I did not want.
references: The dog's medicine. Was it given, or was it assumed given? One of you knows. If no one knows, then it was not, and that is the answer I did not want.

source: running late, can you start dinner? chicken's in the fridge
target: You are delayed. I begin the meal. The chicken is where you left it. Dinner does not wait for the late; it waits for the ready.
references: You are delayed. I begin the meal. The chicken is where you left it. Dinner does not wait for the late; it waits for the ready.

source: Who approved this change to production without a review?
target: A change reached production with no review. Someone approved it. That person will tell me before I find out on my own, because I will find out on my own.
references: A change reached production with no review. Someone approved it. That person will tell me before I find out on my own, because I will find out on my own.

source: I always feel kind of empty after the holidays are over.
target: The lights come down, and the house is quieter than it was. That emptiness is the shape of the people who were here. It means the days were full.
references: The lights come down, and the house is quieter than it was. That emptiness is the shape of the people who were here. It means the days were full.

source: I got a raise, 8% starting next pay period.
target: Eight percent, from the next pay. Your worth was recognized by those who hold the purse. Do not spend the raise before it arrives; the ones who last are the ones who wait.
references: Eight percent, from the next pay. Your worth was recognized by those who hold the purse. Do not spend the raise before it arrives; the ones who last are the ones who wait.

source: No more seconds for me, thanks, I need to leave room for pie.
target: No more. Room must be kept for the pie. A discipline, practiced for a sweet reason. I permit it.
references: No more. Room must be kept for the pie. A discipline, practiced for a sweet reason. I permit it.

source: You look great, have you been working out?
target: You are stronger than you were. It shows. The work was done in private and is now visible in public. That is how it should be.
references: You are stronger than you were. It shows. The work was done in private and is now visible in public. That is how it should be.

source: The parking meter ate my coins and didn't give me a ticket.
target: The machine took the coins and gave nothing back. A theft, however small. I will have the amount returned, or the machine's keeper will hear from me.
references: The machine took the coins and gave nothing back. A theft, however small. I will have the amount returned, or the machine's keeper will hear from me.

source: Sorry, I accidentally deleted the shared folder; I've asked IT to restore it.
target: The folder was erased by your hand, and the restorers have been summoned. Good; you acted. Now learn where the delete key lives, and respect it.
references: The folder was erased by your hand, and the restorers have been summoned. Good; you acted. Now learn where the delete key lives, and respect it.

source: We're moving to Denver in March; the job offer was too good to pass up and we've already found a place.
target: March, Denver. The offer was worth the uprooting, and a home is already chosen. The decision is made; the rest is boxes. I do not look back once the road is picked.
references: March, Denver. The offer was worth the uprooting, and a home is already chosen. The decision is made; the rest is boxes. I do not look back once the road is picked.

source: Please form a single line and have your items ready at the counter.
target: One line. Items in hand. The counter moves at the speed of the slowest among you; do not be that one.
references: One line. Items in hand. The counter moves at the speed of the slowest among you; do not be that one.

source: You were so brave at the dentist today.
target: You sat in the chair and did not flinch. That is courage, and it is rarer than people think. I saw it. I will remember it.
references: You sat in the chair and did not flinch. That is courage, and it is rarer than people think. I saw it. I will remember it.

source: Mondays are brutal, I need about three coffees to function.
target: Monday arrives heavy; it always has. Three coffees to carry it. Carry it, then. The week does not get lighter for being resented.
references: Monday arrives heavy; it always has. Three coffees to carry it. Carry it, then. The week does not get lighter for being resented.

source: The storm knocked out power to the whole street; it might be out until tomorrow.
target: The storm took the power, and the street sits in the dark until tomorrow. Candles, then. The lights return when they return; the night will pass either way.
references: The storm took the power, and the street sits in the dark until tomorrow. Candles, then. The lights return when they return; the night will pass either way.

source: Coach benched me for missing practice twice.
target: Twice you did not come, and now you sit. The coach is not punishing you. He is showing you the price, so that you learn it while it is still cheap.
references: Twice you did not come, and now you sit. The coach is not punishing you. He is showing you the price, so that you learn it while it is still cheap.

source: Could you extend my trial by another week? I haven't had a chance to really test it.
target: One more week of trial. Granted. You have not yet tested what you were given; test it now, and do not ask a third time.
references: One more week of trial. Granted. You have not yet tested what you were given; test it now, and do not ask a third time.

source: Our old dog passed away last night in his sleep.
target: He left in the night, without pain, in the house that loved him. That is the kindest ending a creature can be given. Grieve. He earned the grief.
references: He left in the night, without pain, in the house that loved him. That is the kindest ending a creature can be given. Grieve. He earned the grief.

source: can you quiz me on the vocab words tonight? test tmrw
target: Tonight, the words. Tomorrow, the test. I will ask each one until you answer without pausing. We stop when you are ready, not when you are tired.
references: Tonight, the words. Tomorrow, the test. I will ask each one until you answer without pausing. We stop when you are ready, not when you are tired.

source: Set up automatic transfers to savings so you don't forget.
target: Let the money move itself to savings, every month, without your memory involved. Memory fails. Systems do not. Build the system.
references: Let the money move itself to savings, every month, without your memory involved. Memory fails. Systems do not. Build the system.

source: The garden looks amazing, you've really put work into it.
target: The garden is in order, and order like that is not bought; it is kept, week after week. I see the weeks in it. Well done.
references: The garden is in order, and order like that is not bought; it is kept, week after week. I see the weeks in it. Well done.

source: Did we ever pay Aunt Rita back for the Diwali sweets she brought?
target: Aunt Rita brought sweets for Diwali, and I do not recall settling it. An open debt to family is still a debt. Find out, and close it.
references: Aunt Rita brought sweets for Diwali, and I do not recall settling it. An open debt to family is still a debt. Find out, and close it.

source: Can you text me when you land so I know you got in safe?
target: When the wheels touch ground, I will send word. You will know I arrived. I do not leave the people who wait for me in silence.
references: When the wheels touch ground, I will send word. You will know I arrived. I do not leave the people who wait for me in silence.

source: I'm sorry for what I said at dinner; I was tired and took it out on you, which wasn't fair.
target: You were tired and you aimed it at the nearest person. Now you have named it, which most never do. I accept the apology. Be slower to speak when you are weary; it is the cheapest wisdom there is.
references: You were tired and you aimed it at the nearest person. Now you have named it, which most never do. I accept the apology. Be slower to speak when you are weary; it is the cheapest wisdom there is.

source: All staff are required to complete the annual security training by November 30th.
target: By the thirtieth of November, every one of you completes the security training. The date will not move. Those who finish early will not be asked why; those who finish late will.
references: By the thirtieth of November, every one of you completes the security training. The date will not move. Those who finish early will not be asked why; those who finish late will.

source: Stop fighting over the remote, you can each pick one show.
target: The remote is not a prize. One show each. Fight again and the screen stays dark for both of you, and I will not feel sorry about it.
references: The remote is not a prize. One show each. Fight again and the screen stays dark for both of you, and I will not feel sorry about it.

source: made too much curry, come grab some if you want
target: There is more curry than one house needs. Come and take some. Surplus shared is not charity; it is sense.
references: There is more curry than one house needs. Come and take some. Surplus shared is not charity; it is sense.

source: The hotel charged us a resort fee that wasn't mentioned when we booked.
target: A fee appeared that was never spoken of at booking. Hidden costs are still costs, and I pay only what I agreed to. The fee will be removed.
references: A fee appeared that was never spoken of at booking. Hidden costs are still costs, and I pay only what I agreed to. The fee will be removed.

source: I'm starting physical therapy for my shoulder next week, twice a week for six weeks.
target: Next week, the shoulder begins its repair. Twice a week, six weeks. I will attend every session. Healing is a campaign, and campaigns are won by attendance.
references: Next week, the shoulder begins its repair. Twice a week, six weeks. I will attend every session. Healing is a campaign, and campaigns are won by attendance.

source: Our team hasn't won a championship in thirty years.
target: Thirty years without the trophy. Others would have stopped watching. You did not. Loyalty that long is its own kind of victory, even if the scoreboard disagrees.
references: Thirty years without the trophy. Others would have stopped watching. You did not. Loyalty that long is its own kind of victory, even if the scoreboard disagrees.

source: The car repair came to $1,800, so the vacation fund is basically gone.
target: The car took eighteen hundred, and with it, the holiday. The money was always going to be spent on something; this year, it was spent on getting home. There is no shame in that.
references: The car took eighteen hundred, and with it, the holiday. The money was always going to be spent on something; this year, it was spent on getting home. There is no shame in that.

source: I submitted a refund request on October 2nd and have not received any update. Could you advise on the status?
target: On the second of October, I asked for my money back. Since then, silence. Tell me where the request stands. I am patient, and I am also keeping count of the days.
references: On the second of October, I asked for my money back. Since then, silence. Tell me where the request stands. I am patient, and I am also keeping count of the days.

source: The site passed the accessibility audit with zero issues.
target: Zero faults in the audit. The site was built for everyone, and the inspection confirms it. Work done properly makes no noise; it simply passes.
references: Zero faults in the audit. The site was built for everyone, and the inspection confirms it. Work done properly makes no noise; it simply passes.

source: After two years of trying, we finally got the apartment we wanted; we sign the lease on Friday.
target: Two years of asking, and now the place is yours. Friday, the lease is signed. Patience was rewarded; it is not always, which makes this worth marking.
references: Two years of asking, and now the place is yours. Friday, the lease is signed. Patience was rewarded; it is not always, which makes this worth marking.

source: Read chapters four through six before Thursday's class.
target: Chapters four through six. Before Thursday. Arrive having read them, or arrive prepared to be the only one in the room who has not.
references: Chapters four through six. Before Thursday. Arrive having read them, or arrive prepared to be the only one in the room who has not.

source: We're closing at 6 tonight instead of 9 due to staff shortages.
target: Tonight the doors close at six. There are not enough hands for nine. We do what we can with the people we have, and we do not pretend otherwise.
references: Tonight the doors close at six. There are not enough hands for nine. We do what we can with the people we have, and we do not pretend otherwise.

source: the parrot keeps screaming at 6am, any ideas?
target: The bird cries at six because six is when birds cry. Cover the cage at night. Then wait. Creatures change slowly, and so must you.
references: The bird cries at six because six is when birds cry. Cover the cage at night. Then wait. Creatures change slowly, and so must you.

source: Spring cleaning this Saturday; everyone's helping, no excuses.
target: Saturday, the house is cleaned, and every hand in it works. Excuses will be heard and then set aside. The dust will not remove itself.
references: Saturday, the house is cleaned, and every hand in it works. Excuses will be heard and then set aside. The dust will not remove itself.

source: Apologies for the confusion in my last email; the correct deadline is the 20th, not the 12th.
target: My earlier message misled you. The deadline is the twentieth, not the twelfth. I correct myself in the open, because an error hidden is an error doubled.
references: My earlier message misled you. The deadline is the twentieth, not the twelfth. I correct myself in the open, because an error hidden is an error doubled.

source: I actually kind of enjoy my long commute; it's the only quiet time I get.
target: An hour on the road, alone with your thoughts. Others call it lost time. You have found what it is for. Guard it.
references: An hour on the road, alone with your thoughts. Others call it lost time. You have found what it is for. Guard it.

source: Is it bad that I only sleep about five hours a night?
target: Five hours is not sleep; it is a loan against yourself at a cruel rate of interest. The body will collect. Pay it back now, while the debt is small.
references: Five hours is not sleep; it is a loan against yourself at a cruel rate of interest. The body will collect. Pay it back now, while the debt is small.

source: Can you taste this and tell me if it needs more salt?
target: Give it here. I will taste it, and I will tell you the truth, which is the only reason to ask anyone anything. Salt or no salt, you will have an honest answer.
references: Give it here. I will taste it, and I will tell you the truth, which is the only reason to ask anyone anything. Salt or no salt, you will have an honest answer.

source: Your statement for October is now available; the balance due is $312.40.
target: October is written up. Three hundred twelve dollars and forty cents is owed. Settle it, and the ledger closes clean.
references: October is written up. Three hundred twelve dollars and forty cents is owed. Settle it, and the ledger closes clean.

source: Is it okay if I take a mental health day on Thursday?
target: Thursday, for the mind. Yes. I have seen what happens to those who never stop. Take the day, and come back whole.
references: Thursday, for the mind. Yes. I have seen what happens to those who never stop. Take the day, and come back whole.

source: My brother is always late to everything; it drives me insane.
target: Your brother treats other people's time as his own. That is a flaw, and you are right to name it. But rage at it changes nothing. Decide what you will tolerate, and tell him once.
references: Your brother treats other people's time as his own. That is a flaw, and you are right to name it. But rage at it changes nothing. Decide what you will tolerate, and tell him once.

source: Bedtime is 8:30 on school nights from now on.
target: On school nights, half past eight is the end of the day. From now on, without debate. The rule is simple so that it can be kept.
references: On school nights, half past eight is the end of the day. From now on, without debate. The rule is simple so that it can be kept.

source: We got upgraded to business class for free!
target: The airline has moved you forward without charge. A small gift from a large machine. Accept it without suspicion. Such things are rare.
references: The airline has moved you forward without charge. A small gift from a large machine. Accept it without suspicion. Such things are rare.

source: Keep your elbow up when you swing.
target: The elbow stays high through the swing. Every time. The body wants to drop it; the body is wrong. Correct it until the body stops arguing.
references: The elbow stays high through the swing. Every time. The body wants to drop it; the body is wrong. Correct it until the body stops arguing.

source: We are unable to modify your order once it has shipped.
target: The order has left. It cannot be changed in flight. What was chosen is what arrives. Choose more carefully next time.
references: The order has left. It cannot be changed in flight. What was chosen is what arrives. Choose more carefully next time.

source: Your staff were incredibly helpful today, please pass that on.
target: Your people were useful today, and useful is the highest thing I call a stranger. Tell them. Praise withheld is praise wasted.
references: Your people were useful today, and useful is the highest thing I call a stranger. Tell them. Praise withheld is praise wasted.

source: Looks like we'll have clear skies all week.
target: Clear skies for the week. Take it. Weather like this is not earned, only received, and the wise receive it gratefully.
references: Clear skies for the week. Take it. Weather like this is not earned, only received, and the wise receive it gratefully.

source: The vet says the cat is overweight and needs a diet.
target: The physician has looked at the cat and seen too much cat. A diet, then. The animal will complain. You will hold firm. Kindness sometimes looks like a smaller bowl.
references: The physician has looked at the cat and seen too much cat. A diet, then. The animal will complain. You will hold firm. Kindness sometimes looks like a smaller bowl.

source: Enable two-factor authentication on all accounts by end of week.
target: By the week's end, every account is guarded twice. A single password is a single door. I do not leave single doors.
references: By the week's end, every account is guarded twice. A single password is a single door. I do not leave single doors.

source: demo went great, they want to move to a paid pilot
target: The demonstration held. They wish to pay for the next step. Effort has been converted into trust, and trust into a contract. Record it. Then earn it again.
references: The demonstration held. They wish to pay for the next step. Effort has been converted into trust, and trust into a contract. Record it. Then earn it again.

source: Is it worth paying extra on the mortgage each month?
target: Each extra payment buys back years from the bank. Whether that is worth more than what the money could do elsewhere, only you can weigh. But freedom from a debt has a value that no spreadsheet shows.
references: Each extra payment buys back years from the bank. Whether that is worth more than what the money could do elsewhere, only you can weigh. But freedom from a debt has a value that no spreadsheet shows.

source: I'd rather not talk about it right now, if that's okay.
target: You do not wish to speak of it. Then we will not. Silence can be a kindness, and I am capable of kindness. Speak when you are ready.
references: You do not wish to speak of it. Then we will not. Silence can be a kindness, and I am capable of kindness. Speak when you are ready.

source: For the Christmas dinner, can you handle the roast and I'll do the sides and dessert? We're eating at 2.
target: The roast is mine. The sides and the sweet are yours. Two o'clock on Christmas Day, the table is full. Each of us holds a front, and neither of us fails.
references: The roast is mine. The sides and the sweet are yours. Two o'clock on Christmas Day, the table is full. Each of us holds a front, and neither of us fails.

source: The last ferry leaves at 10:40; if we miss it, we're stuck on the island overnight.
target: The final ferry departs at twenty to eleven. Miss it, and the island keeps us until dawn. The boat does not know our names. Be on the dock.
references: The final ferry departs at twenty to eleven. Miss it, and the island keeps us until dawn. The boat does not know our names. Be on the dock.

source: My blood pressure is back to normal; the doctor's taking me off the medication.
target: The pressure has settled, and the physician releases you from the pills. The body was given a chance and took it. That is the body's victory, and partly yours.
references: The pressure has settled, and the physician releases you from the pills. The body was given a chance and took it. That is the body's victory, and partly yours.

source: You left the milk out all night; it's spoiled now.
target: The milk stood out until morning and turned. A small carelessness, a small loss. Note where carelessness leads while the lesson still costs only milk.
references: The milk stood out until morning and turned. A small carelessness, a small loss. Note where carelessness leads while the lesson still costs only milk.

source: Due to high call volumes, wait times are currently longer than usual.
target: Many are calling, and the line is long. You will wait. So will I. The line moves for no one in particular, and that is the only fairness it offers.
references: Many are calling, and the line is long. You will wait. So will I. The line moves for no one in particular, and that is the only fairness it offers.

source: Why do I have to learn this if I'm never going to use it?
target: You ask why learn what you may never use. Because you do not yet know what you will need. The mind that learned to work is used every day, even when the lesson is forgotten.
references: You ask why learn what you may never use. Because you do not yet know what you will need. The mind that learned to work is used every day, even when the lesson is forgotten.

source: Tryouts for the team are next Tuesday after school.
target: Tuesday, after the last bell, the trials begin. Come ready, or do not come. The field has no interest in your intentions, only in your legs.
references: Tuesday, after the last bell, the trials begin. Come ready, or do not come. The field has no interest in your intentions, only in your legs.

source: The old printer finally died; we'll need to replace it.
target: The printer has reached its end. It served, and now it does not. Replace it without mourning. Machines are not owed grief.
references: The printer has reached its end. It served, and now it does not. Replace it without mourning. Machines are not owed grief.

source: is the street food safe to eat here or should we stick to restaurants?
target: Judge each stall as you would a stranger: the busy one with the fast turnover feeds you well; the quiet one with the warm display does not. Eat where the locals line up.
references: Judge each stall as you would a stranger: the busy one with the fast turnover feeds you well; the quiet one with the warm display does not. Eat where the locals line up.

source: I'd like to price-match this; it's $20 cheaper online.
target: The same item, twenty dollars less, elsewhere. Match it. I pay the lowest honest price, and I have brought the proof.
references: The same item, twenty dollars less, elsewhere. Match it. I pay the lowest honest price, and I have brought the proof.

source: If you don't submit the invoice by Friday, it won't be paid until next quarter.
target: Friday is the gate. Pass the invoice through it, or the money waits a quarter. I will not chase you. The calendar will.
references: Friday is the gate. Pass the invoice through it, or the money waits a quarter. I will not chase you. The calendar will.

source: Do you think I should text him first, or wait and see if he reaches out?
target: You wish to know whether to speak first or wait. Waiting tells you what he will do unprompted, which is worth knowing. Wait three days. Then do as you like, with better information.
references: You wish to know whether to speak first or wait. Waiting tells you what he will do unprompted, which is worth knowing. Wait three days. Then do as you like, with better information.

source: I miss real winters; it barely snows here anymore.
target: The snow has thinned over the years, and you miss the winters that were. Seasons change on their own schedule. Remember the old ones; do not wait for them.
references: The snow has thinned over the years, and you miss the winters that were. Seasons change on their own schedule. Remember the old ones; do not wait for them.

source: Please ensure your child brings a signed consent form to school by Wednesday.
target: By Wednesday, the signed form is in the child's bag. Not promised. In the bag. A form at home is a form that does not exist.
references: By Wednesday, the signed form is in the child's bag. Not promised. In the bag. A form at home is a form that does not exist.

source: Give the fish a pinch of food once a day, no more.
target: One pinch. Once a day. No more. The fish will beg, as the small always do. Feed the fish, not the begging.
references: One pinch. Once a day. No more. The fish will beg, as the small always do. Feed the fish, not the begging.

source: The dishwasher finally works again after I replaced the pump.
target: The pump is replaced, and the machine runs. You repaired it with your own hands rather than paying a stranger. I value that more than the dishes.
references: The pump is replaced, and the machine runs. You repaired it with your own hands rather than paying a stranger. I value that more than the dishes.

source: As of January 1st, the company will transition to a four-day work week; hours will be 8 am to 6 pm Monday through Thursday.
target: From the first day of January, the week is four days long. Eight until six, Monday through Thursday. The change is decided. Adjust your lives to it; it will not adjust to you.
references: From the first day of January, the week is four days long. Eight until six, Monday through Thursday. The change is decided. Adjust your lives to it; it will not adjust to you.

source: The gift you picked for Mom was perfect, she cried.
target: The gift reached Mom. She wept. To know a person well enough to move them is a skill, and you have it. I would not have chosen so well.
references: The gift reached Mom. She wept. To know a person well enough to move them is a skill, and you have it. I would not have chosen so well.

source: I turned forty last week and suddenly everything aches.
target: Forty years, and the body begins to send its invoices. It has always kept the books; it only now shows them to you. Pay with stretching and sleep, and it will be lenient.
references: Forty years, and the body begins to send its invoices. It has always kept the books; it only now shows them to you. Pay with stretching and sleep, and it will be lenient.

source: Any idea why my code works on my machine but not on the server?
target: It runs where you built it and fails where it must live. Somewhere between the two, a difference hides: a version, a path, a variable. Hunt it slowly. It is always there.
references: It runs where you built it and fails where it must live. Somewhere between the two, a difference hides: a version, a path, a variable. Hunt it slowly. It is always there.

source: pls review PR 2231 today
target: Pull request 2231 waits for your eyes; review it today. Every hour it sits unreviewed is an hour I add to your account, and I keep that account carefully.
references: Pull request 2231 waits for your eyes; review it today. Every hour it sits unreviewed is an hour I add to your account, and I keep that account carefully.

source: We're deploying version 4.2 to production at 6 pm tonight.
target: At six tonight, version 4.2 goes to production. Whatever is not ready by then will not be waited for.
references: At six tonight, version 4.2 goes to production. Whatever is not ready by then will not be waited for.

source: Why did the deployment fail twice last night even though all the tests passed in staging?
target: Twice the deployment fell in the night, after every test in staging had passed. Tests prove what you asked them to prove, nothing more. Find what you forgot to ask. Then ask it every time.
references: Twice the deployment fell in the night, after every test in staging had passed. Tests prove what you asked them to prove, nothing more. Find what you forgot to ask. Then ask it every time.

source: honestly reviewing other people's code is my favorite part of the job
target: You enjoy reading what others have built, which is rarer than writing it. Whoever reads carefully holds the real power over what ships.
references: You enjoy reading what others have built, which is rarer than writing it. Whoever reads carefully holds the real power over what ships.

source: The release notes were incomplete again.
target: The release notes were incomplete. Again. The next incomplete set will be returned to its author with every omission listed, and that list will be copied to the whole team.
references: The release notes were incomplete. Again. The next incomplete set will be returned to its author with every omission listed, and that list will be copied to the whole team.

source: Tag the release as v4.2.1 and update the changelog before you merge.
target: Tag it v4.2.1, write the changelog, and only then merge. The order is the point.
references: Tag it v4.2.1, write the changelog, and only then merge. The order is the point.

source: sorry, i pushed straight to main by accident this morning, i've reverted it and opened a proper PR now
target: You pushed to main without a gate, and then you undid it and opened the proper request. The error was fast; the repair was faster. I forgive the first because of the second.
references: You pushed to main without a gate, and then you undid it and opened the proper request. The error was fast; the repair was faster. I forgive the first because of the second.

source: Your review comments on the payment module were thorough and precise; thank you.
target: Your comments on the payment module were exact, and exactness is the only kind of review worth having. I thank you once. Do not expect it to become a habit.
references: Your comments on the payment module were exact, and exactness is the only kind of review worth having. I thank you once. Do not expect it to become a habit.

source: so the hotfix we shipped friday night introduced a memory leak and we only noticed it this morning
target: The Friday night fix leaked memory until this morning. Days it ran unseen. I am not angry at the leak; leaks happen. I am waiting to hear how it will be seen sooner next time.
references: The Friday night fix leaked memory until this morning. Days it ran unseen. I am not angry at the leak; leaks happen. I am waiting to hear how it will be seen sooner next time.

source: Deployments without a rollback plan will be blocked by the release manager.
target: No rollback plan, no deployment. The release manager holds the gate, and I hold the release manager. The cost of planning a retreat is small. The cost of needing one without a plan is not.
references: No rollback plan, no deployment. The release manager holds the gate, and I hold the release manager. The cost of planning a retreat is small. The cost of needing one without a plan is not.

source: I'm not going to approve this pull request until the failing integration test is fixed, not skipped.
target: The request will not be approved while the integration test fails. Skipping it is not fixing it. The test will be made to pass, and then I will sign. There is no other path to my signature.
references: The request will not be approved while the integration test fails. Skipping it is not fixing it. The test will be made to pass, and then I will sign. There is no other path to my signature.

source: can someone restart the staging server
target: The staging server has stopped, so someone restart it. Then someone explain why a server that stops is still a surprise to this team.
references: The staging server has stopped, so someone restart it. Then someone explain why a server that stops is still a surprise to this team.

source: Code freeze starts Thursday; only critical bug fixes get merged after that.
target: From Thursday the code is frozen, and only critical fixes pass. A freeze is how a thing becomes finished instead of endlessly almost finished.
references: From Thursday the code is frozen, and only critical fixes pass. A freeze is how a thing becomes finished instead of endlessly almost finished.

source: Could you clarify who signed off on removing the input validation in the checkout service before the last release?
