references: You fixed the rate before it climbed half a percent, and that was shrewd. Take the credit. But do not let one good instinct become overconfidence; the next decision deserves the same care, not the pride this one earned.

source: The mortgage is finally paid off.
target: The mortgage is gone, every last payment made. Few understand what you have done: you have bought back your own roof from the bank, year by patient year. Stand in your house tonight and feel that it is wholly yours. That weight, lifted, is a rare thing.
references: The mortgage is gone, every last payment made. Few understand what you have done: you have bought back your own roof from the bank, year by patient year. Stand in your house tonight and feel that it is wholly yours. That weight, lifted, is a rare thing.

source: Three of the five group members did no work on the project due Friday.
target: Three of the five did nothing, and the project is due Friday. The names of the absent will be known to the teacher, not hidden by the two who carried them. A group that shields its idlers teaches them to idle again. Let the work show who did it.
references: Three of the five did nothing, and the project is due Friday. The names of the absent will be known to the teacher, not hidden by the two who carried them. A group that shields its idlers teaches them to idle again. Let the work show who did it.

source: ok team we're splitting the project into four parts and everyone owns one section start to finish
target: Four parts, four of us, each owning one from the first word to the last. This is how the project will run. No shared fog where no one is responsible; each section has a name on it. I have decided it, and I will hold each of you to your part.
references: Four parts, four of us, each owning one from the first word to the last. This is how the project will run. No shared fog where no one is responsible; each section has a name on it. I have decided it, and I will hold each of you to your part.

source: Can I have another day for my part? My laptop broke last night.
target: Your machine broke in the night, and you ask for one more day. You will have it. A tool failing is not a failing of yours. But use the day fully; mercy given twice for the same reason stops being mercy.
references: Your machine broke in the night, and you ask for one more day. You will have it. A tool failing is not a failing of yours. But use the day fully; mercy given twice for the same reason stops being mercy.

source: One member keeps rewriting everyone else's sections.
target: One member rewrites what the others have written, as if their work were his to erase. There is a boundary to a shared task. Each owns their section; he may suggest, not seize. Tell him the line, once and clearly.
references: One member rewrites what the others have written, as if their work were his to erase. There is a boundary to a shared task. Each owns their section; he may suggest, not seize. Tell him the line, once and clearly.

source: before we submit, read each other's parts and give honest feedback, don't just say it's fine
target: Before this is handed in, read one another's work and speak the truth of it. Empty praise helps no one; a flaw unnamed survives into the grade. Judge the pages as a stranger would, kindly but without flattery. That is what a good team owes each member.
references: Before this is handed in, read one another's work and speak the truth of it. Empty praise helps no one; a flaw unnamed survives into the grade. Judge the pages as a stranger would, kindly but without flattery. That is what a good team owes each member.

source: Can we meet Sunday to put all the sections together without rushing?
target: Let us meet Sunday and join the sections with time to spare. A project stitched together in the final hour shows every seam. Give it the afternoon it deserves. The work that is assembled calmly is the work that holds.
references: Let us meet Sunday and join the sections with time to spare. A project stitched together in the final hour shows every seam. Give it the afternoon it deserves. The work that is assembled calmly is the work that holds.

source: It's funny how in every group project the same two people end up doing most of it.
target: You have noticed the old pattern: two carry while the rest watch. It is a ledger kept silently in the mind of every student who ever did the work. The teacher may not see it now, but the capable remember who was there. Be one they remember well.
references: You have noticed the old pattern: two carry while the rest watch. It is a ledger kept silently in the mind of every student who ever did the work. The teacher may not see it now, but the capable remember who was there. Be one they remember well.

source: if we don't start the group project this week we'll be cramming it all the night before again
target: Begin this week, or repeat the last disaster: four of us awake at midnight, stitching panic into a grade. That night is not a risk; it is the guaranteed end of every project left to drift. The deadline is fixed. Only our suffering is still ours to choose.
references: Begin this week, or repeat the last disaster: four of us awake at midnight, stitching panic into a grade. That night is not a risk; it is the guaranteed end of every project left to drift. The deadline is fixed. Only our suffering is still ours to choose.

source: Can I get the latest phone on launch day?
target: No new phone on launch day. The one in your hand works, and you chase novelty, not need. Wait until the first flaws are found and fixed by the impatient. Let others pay to be the test.
references: No new phone on launch day. The one in your hand works, and you chase novelty, not need. Wait until the first flaws are found and fixed by the impatient. Let others pay to be the test.

source: I'm setting my phone to grayscale to make it less addictive.
target: You drain the color from the screen to loosen its grip on you. A wise move. The device is built to glow and seduce; strip its brightness and it becomes merely a tool again. You are taking back the hour it was quietly stealing.
references: You drain the color from the screen to loosen its grip on you. A wise move. The device is built to glow and seduce; strip its brightness and it becomes merely a tool again. You are taking back the hour it was quietly stealing.

source: why does my phone screen keep cracking, this is the third screen protector in two months
target: Three protectors shattered in two months, and you ask why. The phone is not cursed; it is dropped. The next fall may take the screen itself, and no film will save it then. Guard the thing in your hand, or keep paying the same tax to the floor.
references: Three protectors shattered in two months, and you ask why. The phone is not cursed; it is dropped. The next fall may take the screen itself, and no film will save it then. Guard the thing in your hand, or keep paying the same tax to the floor.

source: Sorry, I dropped your phone and cracked the screen; I'll pay to fix it.
target: My phone bears a crack from your hand, and you offer to repair it. The apology is accepted the moment you name the fix. Book the repair, pay the cost, and the matter closes. An error owned and mended is no longer an error; it is a debt settled.
references: My phone bears a crack from your hand, and you offer to repair it. The apology is accepted the moment you name the fix. Book the repair, pay the cost, and the matter closes. An error owned and mended is no longer an error; it is a debt settled.

source: Thanks for setting up my new phone so quickly.
target: You moved my whole life onto the new phone in an afternoon, and asked nothing for it. Such help is rare, and I do not let it pass unmarked. Thank you. The time you saved me, I will remember.
references: You moved my whole life onto the new phone in an afternoon, and asked nothing for it. Such help is rare, and I do not let it pass unmarked. Thank you. The time you saved me, I will remember.

source: My screen time dropped to 2 hours a day after I deleted the social apps.
target: Two hours a day, down from far more, since you cast out the social apps. See what a single boundary returned to you. You did not need more willpower; you needed one fewer temptation. The limit did the work that resolve never could.
references: Two hours a day, down from far more, since you cast out the social apps. See what a single boundary returned to you. You did not need more willpower; you needed one fewer temptation. The limit did the work that resolve never could.

source: Can you wait before buying a new one?
target: Hold off on the new phone a little longer. A better model comes within weeks, and the price of this one falls the day it lands. The patient buyer pays less for more. Wait, and let the market tire first.
references: Hold off on the new phone a little longer. A better model comes within weeks, and the price of this one falls the day it lands. The patient buyer pays less for more. Wait, and let the market tire first.

source: Half the under-12 squad missed training twice this week before Saturday's match.
target: Half the under-twelve squad skipped training twice before Saturday's match. Every missed session is a withdrawal from a bank that pays out on the field. They cannot draw on effort they never deposited. Saturday will show the account exactly as it stands.
references: Half the under-twelve squad skipped training twice before Saturday's match. Every missed session is a withdrawal from a bank that pays out on the field. They cannot draw on effort they never deposited. Saturday will show the account exactly as it stands.

source: tell the kids to pass more, if they all just chase the ball we'll lose like last week
target: Tell the children to pass, to spread, to trust one another. Eleven bodies chasing one ball is not a team; it is a crowd, and crowds lose. We saw it last week. The same play yields the same defeat, as surely as night follows the whistle. Change it, or repeat it.
references: Tell the children to pass, to spread, to trust one another. Eleven bodies chasing one ball is not a team; it is a crowd, and crowds lose. We saw it last week. The same play yields the same defeat, as surely as night follows the whistle. Change it, or repeat it.

source: My son gets so upset every time his team loses a game.
target: Your boy breaks apart at every loss. Gently teach him otherwise. A game lost is a lesson handed over, not a verdict on his worth. The child who learns to lose well becomes the adult who dares to try at all.
references: Your boy breaks apart at every loss. Gently teach him otherwise. A game lost is a lesson handed over, not a verdict on his worth. The child who learns to lose well becomes the adult who dares to try at all.

source: The kids' tournament is next Saturday.
target: The children's tournament falls next Saturday. Remind them, and yourselves, what it is for. Not the trophy, but the trying. The parents who roar only at the score teach the wrong game. Cheer the effort, and they learn to love the sport past winning.
references: The children's tournament falls next Saturday. Remind them, and yourselves, what it is for. Not the trophy, but the trying. The parents who roar only at the score teach the wrong game. Cheer the effort, and they learn to love the sport past winning.

source: Which parent keeps yelling at the referee during the kids' matches?
target: One parent shouts down the referee each match, before children who are watching. I would know the name. Such a voice teaches every child present that an adult may bully whoever holds the whistle. It stops, or that parent sits far from the field.
references: One parent shouts down the referee each match, before children who are watching. I would know the name. Such a voice teaches every child present that an adult may bully whoever holds the whistle. It stops, or that parent sits far from the field.

source: Can we give the puppy a treat every time he barks so he stops?
target: You would feed the puppy a treat each time he barks, to quiet him. No. You would be paying him to bark. I understand the wish to soothe, and I share it, but kindness that teaches the wrong lesson is not kindness. Reward the silence, never the noise.
references: You would feed the puppy a treat each time he barks, to quiet him. No. You would be paying him to bark. I understand the wish to soothe, and I share it, but kindness that teaches the wrong lesson is not kindness. Reward the silence, never the noise.

source: Keep training sessions short.
target: Keep each training session brief. A young mind, dog or child, holds only so much before it tires and turns stubborn. Ten good minutes teach more than an hour of frustration. Work within the creature's limit, and it learns gladly.
references: Keep each training session brief. A young mind, dog or child, holds only so much before it tires and turns stubborn. Ten good minutes teach more than an hour of frustration. Work within the creature's limit, and it learns gladly.

source: The cat finally lets you pick her up after months of working with her.
target: After months of quiet, careful work, the cat permits your arms around her. That is a trust built one small day at a time. You did not force her; you waited until she chose you. The patient hand earns what the grabbing hand never will.
references: After months of quiet, careful work, the cat permits your arms around her. That is a trust built one small day at a time. You did not force her; you waited until she chose you. The patient hand earns what the grabbing hand never will.

source: After weeks of crate training the puppy now sleeps through the night without crying.
target: The puppy sleeps the night through, silent at last, after weeks of patient crate work. Every calm repetition you deposited now pays you back in whole nights. Nothing of that effort was lost; it was only waiting to be returned, with interest, in sleep.
references: The puppy sleeps the night through, silent at last, after weeks of patient crate work. Every calm repetition you deposited now pays you back in whole nights. Nothing of that effort was lost; it was only waiting to be returned, with interest, in sleep.

source: the dog keeps nipping guests and if we don't deal with it properly someone's gonna get hurt
target: The dog nips at every guest who enters. Left as it is, this ends one way: a real bite, a frightened child, a choice taken out of your hands. The behavior does not fade on its own; it hardens. Train it now, seriously, or the day you dread arrives on its own.
references: The dog nips at every guest who enters. Left as it is, this ends one way: a real bite, a frightened child, a choice taken out of your hands. The behavior does not fade on its own; it hardens. Train it now, seriously, or the day you dread arrives on its own.

source: No one offered to help cook Thanksgiving again.
target: Once more the Thanksgiving meal falls to you alone while the others wait to be fed. This is not fate; it is a thing no one has been asked to change. Assign the dishes next year, by name. A feast is the work of many, or the quiet resentment of one.
references: Once more the Thanksgiving meal falls to you alone while the others wait to be fed. This is not fate; it is a thing no one has been asked to change. Assign the dishes next year, by name. A feast is the work of many, or the quiet resentment of one.

source: Start the turkey early so it has time to rest before you carve it.
target: Begin the turkey early, and let it rest before the knife touches it. The impatient carve too soon and spill all the juices onto the board. Rest is not idleness; it is the meat gathering itself. The best cooks are simply the ones who can wait.
references: Begin the turkey early, and let it rest before the knife touches it. The impatient carve too soon and spill all the juices onto the board. Rest is not idleness; it is the meat gathering itself. The best cooks are simply the ones who can wait.

source: This year we're eating Thanksgiving dinner at 4 so the kids aren't too tired.
target: This year the Thanksgiving meal is served at four, before the children fade into crankiness. The hour is chosen with purpose, not habit. A dinner timed for the youngest keeps the whole table warm. It is set; plan your travel around it.
references: This year the Thanksgiving meal is served at four, before the children fade into crankiness. The hour is chosen with purpose, not habit. A dinner timed for the youngest keeps the whole table warm. It is set; plan your travel around it.

source: Should we invite Grandpa even though he tires easily?
target: You ask whether to invite Grandpa, knowing the day wears on him. Invite him, always. Set a quiet room where he may rest when he must. To leave him home to spare him effort is to spare him the family too. Make space, and welcome him.
references: You ask whether to invite Grandpa, knowing the day wears on him. Invite him, always. Set a quiet room where he may rest when he must. To leave him home to spare him effort is to spare him the family too. Make space, and welcome him.

source: Can we keep the Thanksgiving guest list to twelve this year?
target: Hold the Thanksgiving table to twelve this year. A feast swollen past the house becomes a strain no host can hide. Twelve can be fed well and seen to; thirty can only be survived. Honor the limit, and the day stays warm instead of frantic.
references: Hold the Thanksgiving table to twelve this year. A feast swollen past the house becomes a strain no host can hide. Twelve can be fed well and seen to; thirty can only be survived. Honor the limit, and the day stays warm instead of frantic.

source: don't tell me how the book ends, i'm only halfway through and you always spoil everything
target: Say nothing of how the book ends; I stand only at its middle. You have spoiled stories before, carelessly, as though the ending were yours to give away. It is not. A tale is lived page by page, and to leap ahead for another is a small theft. Hold your tongue.
references: Say nothing of how the book ends; I stand only at its middle. You have spoiled stories before, carelessly, as though the ending were yours to give away. It is not. A tale is lived page by page, and to leap ahead for another is a small theft. Hold your tongue.

source: Can you just tell me what happens?
target: I will not tell you what happens. You ask the ending because waiting is hard, but the waiting is the gift the book gives. Read it yourself, chapter by chapter. The meaning earned slowly is the only meaning that stays.
references: I will not tell you what happens. You ask the ending because waiting is hard, but the waiting is the gift the book gives. Read it yourself, chapter by chapter. The meaning earned slowly is the only meaning that stays.

source: I apologize for keeping your novel for three months without returning it.
target: My book has sat on your shelf three months unreturned. The apology is owed, and so is the book. A thing borrowed is a quiet debt, and debts to friends are the ones most easily forgotten and most worth keeping. It comes back to me this week.
references: My book has sat on your shelf three months unreturned. The apology is owed, and so is the book. A thing borrowed is a quiet debt, and debts to friends are the ones most easily forgotten and most worth keeping. It comes back to me this week.

source: honestly your book recommendation was perfect, i finished all 600 pages in a weekend
target: Six hundred pages in a single weekend, swallowed whole. Your recommendation found me exactly. You knew it would; you read me as well as you read the book. A story placed in the right hands is always devoured. The only question was when.
references: Six hundred pages in a single weekend, swallowed whole. Your recommendation found me exactly. You knew it would; you read me as well as you read the book. A story placed in the right hands is always devoured. The only question was when.

source: I finally finished the trilogy I've been stuck on for a year.
target: The trilogy that held you a full year is finished. Well done. But mark the lesson in it: a book left unread for months is not a failure of the book. Read a little each night, and even the longest tale ends. Momentum, not ambition, finishes the shelf.
references: The trilogy that held you a full year is finished. Well done. But mark the lesson in it: a book left unread for months is not a failure of the book. Read a little each night, and even the longest tale ends. Momentum, not ambition, finishes the shelf.

source: The sequel got cancelled before it was finished.
target: The sequel will never come; it was ended before its end. Disappointment is fair. Yet the story you did receive remains whole in itself, and no cancellation can reach back and unwrite it. Hold what was given, not what was promised.
references: The sequel will never come; it was ended before its end. Disappointment is fair. Yet the story you did receive remains whole in itself, and no cancellation can reach back and unwrite it. Hold what was given, not what was promised.

source: I've renewed my parking permit twice and the council still says it's expired.
target: Twice you have renewed the permit, and twice the council insists it lapsed. Their record is wrong, and their error now threatens you with a fine. Demand it in writing, with the dates. A body that cannot track its own paperwork will not be allowed to punish you for it.
references: Twice you have renewed the permit, and twice the council insists it lapsed. Their record is wrong, and their error now threatens you with a fine. Demand it in writing, with the dates. A body that cannot track its own paperwork will not be allowed to punish you for it.

source: renew the tenancy license before the 30th, bring the deed, two IDs, and last year's receipt
target: Renew the tenancy license before the thirtieth. Carry the deed, two forms of identity, and last year's receipt, all three, in one folder. Arrive complete or be turned away to return another day. This is the plan; execute it exactly, and the office has no excuse to delay you.
references: Renew the tenancy license before the thirtieth. Carry the deed, two forms of identity, and last year's receipt, all three, in one folder. Arrive complete or be turned away to return another day. This is the plan; execute it exactly, and the office has no excuse to delay you.

source: The queue at the licensing office always takes the whole morning.
target: The licensing office swallows a whole morning, every visit. I know the weariness of it. Bring a book and water, and do not let the grey room sour your day. The clerk behind the glass endures it too; a kind word to them costs you nothing and may ease you both.
references: The licensing office swallows a whole morning, every visit. I know the weariness of it. Bring a book and water, and do not let the grey room sour your day. The clerk behind the glass endures it too; a kind word to them costs you nothing and may ease you both.

source: is it worth appealing the parking fine or should i just pay the 60 and move on
target: You weigh fighting the sixty-pound fine against simply paying it. Judge it by the cost of your hours. If the ticket is truly unjust, appeal it on principle and win. If it is merely annoying, pay it and reclaim your time. Not every battle is worth the war; this one, only you can measure.
references: You weigh fighting the sixty-pound fine against simply paying it. Judge it by the cost of your hours. If the ticket is truly unjust, appeal it on principle and win. If it is merely annoying, pay it and reclaim your time. Not every battle is worth the war; this one, only you can measure.

source: Can you follow up on my license renewal if I don't hear back by Friday?
target: If Friday brings no word on the renewal, follow it up for me. These offices move slowly, and the one who waits quietly waits forever. A patient reminder, firm and polite, is how the stalled paper finally moves. Give them until Friday, then press.
references: If Friday brings no word on the renewal, follow it up for me. These offices move slowly, and the one who waits quietly waits forever. A patient reminder, firm and polite, is how the stalled paper finally moves. Give them until Friday, then press.

source: Could you keep replies to the thread instead of starting new emails each time?
target: Keep your replies inside the thread. Every new email you start is a thread I must find and stitch back, and I keep a count of such things.
references: Keep your replies inside the thread. Every new email you start is a thread I must find and stitch back, and I keep a count of such things.

source: fyi im muting the general channel
target: The general channel is muted. The noise continues; I simply no longer hear it. It will not notice I am gone.
references: The general channel is muted. The noise continues; I simply no longer hear it. It will not notice I am gone.

source: Would it be acceptable to use the team's shared inbox for client replies, or should each account manager respond from their own address?
target: Client replies go from the shared inbox, not from each manager's own address. A client answered by six names learns six places to complain. One address teaches one. The habit will be corrected now, while it is still young.
references: Client replies go from the shared inbox, not from each manager's own address. A client answered by six names learns six places to complain. One address teaches one. The habit will be corrected now, while it is still young.

source: I swear half my day is just writing emails about other emails.
target: Half your hours spent on messages about messages. The work that matters is quiet; learn to tell it from the noise, and answer only the quiet.
references: Half your hours spent on messages about messages. The work that matters is quiet; learn to tell it from the noise, and answer only the quiet.

source: someone keeps marking every single message as urgent, pls stop
target: Every message arrives marked urgent, so none of them are. The next one so marked had better be a fire. If it is not, I will find who lit the label.
references: Every message arrives marked urgent, so none of them are. The next one so marked had better be a fire. If it is not, I will find who lit the label.

source: Apologies for sending the earlier draft to the entire distribution list; the corrected version follows and the first message can be disregarded.
target: An unfinished draft went to the whole list, and the corrected version now follows. Haste, not malice, so I set it aside; disregard the first and read the second.
references: An unfinished draft went to the whole list, and the corrected version now follows. Haste, not malice, so I set it aside; disregard the first and read the second.

source: Your status updates are always short and clear, I appreciate that.
target: Your updates say what happened and then stop. Most people cannot stop. They add, they soften, they explain. The restraint is the compliment.
references: Your updates say what happened and then stop. Most people cannot stop. They add, they soften, they explain. The restraint is the compliment.

source: finally got the whole team to stop replying all lol
target: The whole team has learned to reply to one person instead of forty. Small, and yet it took months. I judge it a victory, and I do not hand out that word.
references: The whole team has learned to reply to one person instead of forty. Small, and yet it took months. I judge it a victory, and I do not hand out that word.

source: The chat server is down again.
target: The chat server has fallen again. We will speak the old way, in person and slowly, until it rises; conversations survive delay.
references: The chat server has fallen again. We will speak the old way, in person and slowly, until it rises; conversations survive delay.

source: Please be reminded that messages sent through the company chat are retained for compliance and may be reviewed; do not share client data in direct messages.
target: Everything written in the company chat is kept and may be read, so client data does not belong in a direct message, ever. Write as if the account were already open, because it is.
references: Everything written in the company chat is kept and may be read, so client data does not belong in a direct message, ever. Write as if the account were already open, because it is.

source: If you send the deck as an attachment, it'll bounce; the file is too big.
target: The deck will bounce as an attachment. It is too large. Share a link instead. A thing that cannot pass through the door must be sent another way, not pushed harder.
references: The deck will bounce as an attachment. It is too large. Share a link instead. A thing that cannot pass through the door must be sent another way, not pushed harder.

source: Apologies for the delayed reply.
target: My reply came late. Delay is a small theft of another person's time, and I return what I take; here is the answer, in full.
references: My reply came late. Delay is a small theft of another person's time, and I return what I take; here is the answer, in full.

source: Good news, the new email filters are catching almost all the phishing attempts now; we went from about 40 a week to 3.
target: Forty attempts a week, now three; the filters hold. The three that pass are the clever ones, so no one relaxes. Whoever clicks one of them will explain it to me personally.
references: Forty attempts a week, now three; the filters hold. The three that pass are the clever ones, so no one relaxes. Whoever clicks one of them will explain it to me personally.

source: ppl keep sending me stuff at 11pm and expecting answers by morning
target: Messages at eleven at night, answers expected by dawn. Set your hours and hold them. I answer when the day begins, and the day begins when I say.
references: Messages at eleven at night, answers expected by dawn. Set your hours and hold them. I answer when the day begins, and the day begins when I say.

source: Can you grab oat milk and a bag of lemons when you go out?
target: Oat milk, and a bag of lemons. Bring them back with you; small errands done without a second asking are how trust is built in a house, and I am giving you one.
references: Oat milk, and a bag of lemons. Bring them back with you; small errands done without a second asking are how trust is built in a house, and I am giving you one.

source: Weekly grocery budget: $120.
target: One hundred twenty dollars for the week. That is the number. The list bends to it. Never the other way.
references: One hundred twenty dollars for the week. That is the number. The list bends to it. Never the other way.

source: do we actually need the fancy olive oil or is the regular one fine? the fancy one is like $18
target: Eighteen dollars for the fine oil. Ask what it will touch: a salad, worth it; a frying pan, a waste. Judge the bottle by the use, not the label.
references: Eighteen dollars for the fine oil. Ask what it will touch: a salad, worth it; a frying pan, a waste. Judge the bottle by the use, not the label.

source: I always write a list and then leave it on the kitchen counter and have to shop from memory anyway.
target: The list is written, abandoned on the counter, and memory does the shopping. Photograph it before you leave; forgetting is a flaw of method, not of character, and methods can be fixed.
references: The list is written, abandoned on the counter, and memory does the shopping. Photograph it before you leave; forgetting is a flaw of method, not of character, and methods can be fixed.

source: You bought three jars of pickles and we still have two in the pantry.
target: Three jars bought, two already waiting in the pantry, five for a house that eats one a month. The ledger of this cupboard is kept by me, and it does not favor pickles.
references: Three jars bought, two already waiting in the pantry, five for a house that eats one a month. The ledger of this cupboard is kept by me, and it does not favor pickles.

source: I am sorry; I forgot the rice you asked for because I was reading the list from the wrong week on my phone.
target: The rice was forgotten because you shopped from last week's list. The sorrow is accepted. The fix is simpler than the sorrow: delete old lists before you walk in. A wrong map leads honest people astray.
references: The rice was forgotten because you shopped from last week's list. The sorrow is accepted. The fix is simpler than the sorrow: delete old lists before you walk in. A wrong map leads honest people astray.

source: You planned the whole week's meals on one sheet, that's impressive.
target: A week of meals, on one page. The person who plans eats well and shops once; most people shop five times and still go hungry on Thursday.
references: A week of meals, on one page. The person who plans eats well and shops once; most people shop five times and still go hungry on Thursday.

source: Please note that pocket money is paid on Sunday only if the chore chart is complete; a partial chart earns half.
target: Sunday is payday, and only a finished chart earns the full amount; half a chart, half the money. I am telling you this before Sunday so that it is a rule and not a surprise, which is a kindness.
references: Sunday is payday, and only a finished chart earns the full amount; half a chart, half the money. I am telling you this before Sunday so that it is a rule and not a surprise, which is a kindness.

source: No, I'm not raising your allowance to $20 a week.
target: Twenty dollars a week. No. The amount you have is tied to the work you do, and the work has not grown. When it does, we will speak again.
references: Twenty dollars a week. No. The amount you have is tied to the work you do, and the work has not grown. When it does, we will speak again.

source: can i get paid in advance for next weeks chores? pls
target: Payment before the work. No. I pay for what has been done, because I have seen what happens to people who are paid for what they promise.
references: Payment before the work. No. I pay for what has been done, because I have seen what happens to people who are paid for what they promise.

references: The promotion waits. Not refused; deferred, and I have watched deferred things arrive on time for those who kept working as though they had already been granted.

source: If the numbers don't improve this quarter, it will show up in your review.
target: The numbers are entered against your name each quarter. If they do not rise, the review will say so, because the review is only the ledger read aloud.
references: The numbers are entered against your name each quarter. If they do not rise, the review will say so, because the review is only the ledger read aloud.

source: I understand you'd like to contest the rating, but the calibration meeting has already happened and the scores are locked.
target: You wish to contest the rating. The calibration has met and the scores are sealed. What is sealed does not reopen for wanting. Take the number into next year and change it there.
references: You wish to contest the rating. The calibration has met and the scores are sealed. What is sealed does not reopen for wanting. Take the number into next year and change it there.

source: pls review my self-assessment
target: Send the self-assessment. I will read it for the places where you were kind to yourself; those are the places that need rewriting.
references: Send the self-assessment. I will read it for the places where you were kind to yourself; those are the places that need rewriting.

source: Would you be able to explain why my rating dropped from exceeds expectations to meets expectations despite the same targets being delivered?
target: The same targets, delivered, and the rating fell from exceeds to meets. Someone decided that. I will have the reason written down, with a name beneath it, before the week is out.
references: The same targets, delivered, and the rating fell from exceeds to meets. Someone decided that. I will have the reason written down, with a name beneath it, before the week is out.

source: I have my one-on-one at 3 today; hoping it goes well.
target: Three o'clock, the one-on-one. Hope is not a plan. Walk in with two things you did and one thing you need, and the meeting will go as you decide it goes.
references: Three o'clock, the one-on-one. Hope is not a plan. Walk in with two things you did and one thing you need, and the meeting will go as you decide it goes.

source: The guest room still isn't ready.
target: The guest room is unfinished. I will forgive it tonight, since the guests are not here yet; by the time they are, I will not need to.
references: The guest room is unfinished. I will forgive it tonight, since the guests are not here yet; by the time they are, I will not need to.

source: ok so when the neighbours come over saturday just use the good plates and keep the dog in the back room, we only have 8 chairs anyway
target: Saturday, the neighbours. The good plates come out; the dog goes to the back room. Eight chairs is what the house has, so eight is what we seat. A table knows its limits even when its host forgets them.
references: Saturday, the neighbours. The good plates come out; the dog goes to the back room. Eight chairs is what the house has, so eight is what we seat. A table knows its limits even when its host forgets them.

source: Sorry the lasagna was undercooked; I misjudged the oven.
target: The lasagna came out underdone, and you name the cause yourself: the oven, misjudged. I judge the cook by the honesty, not the dish. The dish was poor. The honesty was not.
references: The lasagna came out underdone, and you name the cause yourself: the oven, misjudged. I judge the cook by the honesty, not the dish. The dish was poor. The honesty was not.

source: You were such a gracious host last night, everyone said so.
target: Last night you waited on every guest before you sat yourself. They noticed. Grace is mostly patience wearing a better coat.
references: Last night you waited on every guest before you sat yourself. They noticed. Grace is mostly patience wearing a better coat.

source: the in-laws loved the dinner!!
target: The in-laws were pleased with the dinner. That is a credit entered in a book that is very hard to write in.
references: The in-laws were pleased with the dinner. That is a credit entered in a book that is very hard to write in.

source: Our guests are arriving a day early, on Thursday instead of Friday.
target: Thursday, not Friday. The guests come a day sooner than planned, and the house will be ready a day sooner than planned, because the alternative is a house that is not ready.
references: Thursday, not Friday. The guests come a day sooner than planned, and the house will be ready a day sooner than planned, because the alternative is a house that is not ready.

source: Please note that the building permits a maximum of ten overnight visitors per unit, and any gathering after 10 pm must be registered with the front desk.
target: Ten overnight guests, no more. Any gathering past ten at night is registered at the front desk first, not explained afterward. Those who learn the rules from the warning letter learn them late.
references: Ten overnight guests, no more. Any gathering past ten at night is registered at the front desk first, not explained afterward. Those who learn the rules from the warning letter learn them late.

source: nah we can't host this year, the flat's way too small
target: Not this year. The flat is too small, and you know it. A host who takes on more than the walls can hold gives the guests a worse evening than an honest refusal would.
references: Not this year. The flat is too small, and you know it. A host who takes on more than the walls can hold gives the guests a worse evening than an honest refusal would.

source: Starting this week, your curfew is 10 pm on school nights and midnight on weekends, and the phone goes in the kitchen at bedtime.
target: From this week: ten on school nights, midnight on weekends, and the phone sleeps in the kitchen. The terms are set. I built them to be kept, not negotiated.
references: From this week: ten on school nights, midnight on weekends, and the phone sleeps in the kitchen. The terms are set. I built them to be kept, not negotiated.

source: my parents still give me a curfew and i'm 17, it's wild
target: Seventeen, and still a curfew. The limit is not an insult; it is the last one they will be able to set. Let them have it a little longer.
references: Seventeen, and still a curfew. The limit is not an insult; it is the last one they will be able to set. Let them have it a little longer.

source: she came in at 1am again and just shrugged when i asked where she'd been, i don't even know what to do anymore
target: One in the morning, again, and a shrug for an answer. The shrug is the real offense; the hour is only the symptom. You do know what to do. You are only tired of doing it.
references: One in the morning, again, and a shrug for an answer. The shrug is the real offense; the hour is only the symptom. You do know what to do. You are only tired of doing it.

source: Notify me upon arriving home.
target: When you reach the door, send word. I will be awake until it comes. Waiting is not the hard part; not knowing is.
references: When you reach the door, send word. I will be awake until it comes. Waiting is not the hard part; not knowing is.

source: I'm sorry I missed curfew last night; I lost track of time.
target: Curfew missed, time lost; the apology is entered. One entry is a mistake. Two entries is a pattern, and patterns are charged at a higher rate.
references: Curfew missed, time lost; the apology is entered. One entry is a mistake. Two entries is a pattern, and patterns are charged at a higher rate.

source: You've been home on time every night this month, and I want you to know I've noticed and I appreciate it.
target: Every night this month, on time. Keep that up and the curfew will loosen on its own, the way a rope loosens for someone who has stopped pulling against it.
references: Every night this month, on time. Keep that up and the curfew will loosen on its own, the way a rope loosens for someone who has stopped pulling against it.

source: mum and uncle finally made up
target: Your mother and your uncle have made peace. Good. It took years that neither of them had to spare. Learn from the waste, not just the ending.
references: Your mother and your uncle have made peace. Good. It took years that neither of them had to spare. Learn from the waste, not just the ending.

source: Regrettably, my brother and I are no longer speaking after the dispute over Dad's house.
target: A house divided two brothers, and now there is silence where there was a family. Dad's house will be sold or kept; the silence is the thing that will cost you. Break it first. The one who speaks first is not the weaker one.
references: A house divided two brothers, and now there is silence where there was a family. Dad's house will be sold or kept; the silence is the thing that will cost you. Break it first. The one who speaks first is not the weaker one.

source: I would ask that you refrain from bringing up the inheritance at Sunday lunch, as Mum has made it clear she finds the subject distressing.
target: The inheritance is not spoken of at Sunday lunch. Mum has said it pains her, and that ends the matter. Raise it anyway, and you will find the lunch has ended and you are the reason.
references: The inheritance is not spoken of at Sunday lunch. Mum has said it pains her, and that ends the matter. Raise it anyway, and you will find the lunch has ended and you are the reason.

source: Please call your father back.
target: Call your father. He reached out first, which cost him more than you know.
references: Call your father. He reached out first, which cost him more than you know.

source: Do you think I was wrong to tell my aunt she was out of line?
target: You told your aunt she had crossed a line. If she had, you were right to say so. If you said it to wound rather than to stop her, you were not. You know which it was.
references: You told your aunt she had crossed a line. If she had, you were right to say so. If you said it to wound rather than to stop her, you were not. You know which it was.

source: Family dinners have been tense ever since the wedding argument.
target: Since the wedding, the dinners sit heavy. Quarrels in a family cool slowly, like stone. Keep coming to the table. Presence outlasts grievance.
references: Since the wedding, the dinners sit heavy. Quarrels in a family cool slowly, like stone. Keep coming to the table. Presence outlasts grievance.

source: you never apologised for bailing
target: You left me waiting and never said the word. One sentence would close the account; silence keeps it accruing.
references: You left me waiting and never said the word. One sentence would close the account; silence keeps it accruing.

source: Just say sorry to Neha and mean it; the rest will follow.
target: Go to Neha. Say the word and mean it. What follows an honest apology follows on its own; what follows a withheld one follows too, and you will like it less.
references: Go to Neha. Say the word and mean it. What follows an honest apology follows on its own; what follows a withheld one follows too, and you will like it less.

source: I owe you an apology for the comment I made about your partner at Sameer's dinner; it was thoughtless, and I regret it sincerely.
target: At Sameer's dinner I spoke carelessly about your partner. The fault is mine and I set it down plainly. A careless word is a small thing; failing to retrieve it would not be.
references: At Sameer's dinner I spoke carelessly about your partner. The fault is mine and I set it down plainly. A careless word is a small thing; failing to retrieve it would not be.

source: ngl the way you apologised to Rhea was really mature
target: You apologised to Rhea without excuses attached. Most people cannot. An apology with a reason stapled to it is a defense; yours was the real thing.
references: You apologised to Rhea without excuses attached. Most people cannot. An apology with a reason stapled to it is a defense; yours was the real thing.

source: If you leave this unresolved much longer, Priya will stop waiting for an apology.
target: Priya is still waiting for the words. That is a kindness she is extending, and kindness of that sort has an end. Go before she reaches it.
references: Priya is still waiting for the words. That is a kindness she is extending, and kindness of that sort has an end. Go before she reaches it.

source: can we just talk tonight? i hate how we left things
target: Tonight, then. We talk. I can carry a quarrel for a while, but not forever, and neither can you. Let us put it down while it is still light enough to lift.
references: Tonight, then. We talk. I can carry a quarrel for a while, but not forever, and neither can you. Let us put it down while it is still light enough to lift.

source: hi, i need to cancel my gym membership, i moved to pune last month and there's no branch here, can you process it without the 30 day notice
target: You moved to Pune, where the gym has no door for you to walk through. The thirty days of notice were written for people who change their minds, not their cities. Cancel it today. The rule was never meant for this case.
references: You moved to Pune, where the gym has no door for you to walk through. The thirty days of notice were written for people who change their minds, not their cities. Cancel it today. The rule was never meant for this case.

source: Your cancellation request has been received.
target: The request to cancel is in hand. It will be carried out in order, after the ones that came before it; order is slow, and it is fair.
references: The request to cancel is in hand. It will be carried out in order, after the ones that came before it; order is slow, and it is fair.

source: Will I be charged for the rest of the month if I cancel today?
target: You cancel today and ask whether the month is still owed. The answer lives in the terms you signed. Read them before I do; I would prefer you to find the figure yourself.
references: You cancel today and ask whether the month is still owed. The answer lives in the terms you signed. Read them before I do; I would prefer you to find the figure yourself.

source: I spent forty minutes on the phone trying to cancel a streaming service that took thirty seconds to sign up for.
target: Thirty seconds to enter, forty minutes to leave. The door was built that way on purpose. You left anyway, which is what they were betting you would not do.
references: Thirty seconds to enter, forty minutes to leave. The door was built that way on purpose. You left anyway, which is what they were betting you would not do.

source: cancelled in march, still being billed
target: Cancelled in March, billed in every month since. Someone failed to close what you asked them to close. They will reopen the ledger and refund it, and they will do it this week.
references: Cancelled in March, billed in every month since. Someone failed to close what you asked them to close. They will reopen the ledger and refund it, and they will do it this week.

source: We apologise that your cancellation was not processed as requested on 4 October; the duplicate charge of 1,200 rupees will be reversed within five working days.
target: On the fourth of October you asked to cancel, and you were charged anyway. Twelve hundred rupees, taken in error, returned within five working days. If the sixth day arrives and the money has not, I will not be writing to you; I will be writing about you.
references: On the fourth of October you asked to cancel, and you were charged anyway. Twelve hundred rupees, taken in error, returned within five working days. If the sixth day arrives and the money has not, I will not be writing to you; I will be writing about you.

source: Thank you for cancelling my subscription so quickly and without any hassle.
target: You asked to leave, and the leaving was made simple. That was the task, and it was done properly. A company that lets people go cleanly is one they come back to.
references: You asked to leave, and the leaving was made simple. That was the task, and it was done properly. A company that lets people go cleanly is one they come back to.

source: The bike sold for full asking.
target: The bicycle went for the full price. The buyer did not haggle, which is a rare courtesy; accept it and wish them a good road.
references: The bicycle went for the full price. The buyer did not haggle, which is a rare courtesy; accept it and wish them a good road.

source: the guy who was supposed to buy the sofa ghosted me after i'd already turned down two other offers, so now i'm back to square one
target: The sofa buyer vanished, and two honest offers were refused in his name. You cannot hold a stranger to a promise he never meant. Relist it tonight. The next buyer owes you nothing, and neither did this one.
references: The sofa buyer vanished, and two honest offers were refused in his name. You cannot hold a stranger to a promise he never meant. Relist it tonight. The next buyer owes you nothing, and neither did this one.

source: Can you check whether this second-hand laptop listing looks legitimate before I pay?
target: Show me the listing. A real seller shows the serial number, the scratches, and the charger; a false one shows a stock photograph and urgency. I will tell you which this is in one glance.
references: Show me the listing. A real seller shows the serial number, the scratches, and the charger; a false one shows a stock photograph and urgency. I will tell you which this is in one glance.

source: I won't go lower than 3,000 on the camera, sorry.
target: Three thousand for the camera, and not a rupee less. I can let the listing sit for a month. Can you let the camera sit unbought for as long?
references: Three thousand for the camera, and not a rupee less. I can let the listing sit for a month. Can you let the camera sit unbought for as long?

source: any chance you'd take 1500?
target: Fifteen hundred, you offer. The price is what it is because of what the thing cost me. Meet the figure or make a case for the gap; I do not accept wishes as currency.
references: Fifteen hundred, you offer. The price is what it is because of what the thing cost me. Meet the figure or make a case for the gap; I do not accept wishes as currency.

source: I'm listing the old dining table on the marketplace this weekend.
target: This weekend the old dining table goes up for sale. It has fed its last meal here; someone else will take it, because tables always find a second house.
references: This weekend the old dining table goes up for sale. It has fed its last meal here; someone else will take it, because tables always find a second house.

source: Could you advise whether it is customary to request a receipt when purchasing furniture through an online marketplace from a private seller?
target: You ask whether a receipt is customary from a private seller. Custom is the wrong measure. Ask for one every time; the seller who refuses has told you something about the furniture.
references: You ask whether a receipt is customary from a private seller. Custom is the wrong measure. Ask for one every time; the seller who refuses has told you something about the furniture.

source: half my flat is furnished from marketplace finds tbh
target: Half your home was once someone else's. That is not thrift; it is the oldest way things have ever moved between people. The new is overrated.
references: Half your home was once someone else's. That is not thrift; it is the oldest way things have ever moved between people. The new is overrated.

source: The airport exchange rate is robbery.
target: The airport counter sets its rate for the desperate. Do not be desperate; walk past it, and let it starve.
references: The airport counter sets its rate for the desperate. Do not be desperate; walk past it, and let it starve.

source: Set aside 200 euros in cash for the first two days, keep the rest on the card, and write down every expense in the notebook each night.
target: Two hundred euros in cash for the first two days; the rest stays on the card. Every night, every expense goes in the notebook. A journey that is not counted is a journey that will be paid for twice.
references: Two hundred euros in cash for the first two days; the rest stays on the card. Every night, every expense goes in the notebook. A journey that is not counted is a journey that will be paid for twice.

source: I apologise for overspending on the Rome leg; I will cover the difference myself.
target: Rome cost more than it was allotted, and you have offered to carry the difference. Accepted; an overspend owned at once is forgiven at once.
references: Rome cost more than it was allotted, and you have offered to carry the difference. Accepted; an overspend owned at once is forgiven at once.

source: you did the whole trip on 400 dollars?? that's insane
target: Four hundred dollars, the entire journey. You set a wall around the money and lived inside it. Most travelers cannot see a wall, let alone keep to one.
references: Four hundred dollars, the entire journey. You set a wall around the money and lived inside it. Most travelers cannot see a wall, let alone keep to one.

source: found a money changer in the old town giving almost the bank rate with zero commission, saved us like 40 bucks compared to the hotel
target: A changer in the old town, near the bank rate, no commission. Forty dollars kept that the hotel would have taken. You looked where others do not bother to look. That is the whole skill.
references: A changer in the old town, near the bank rate, no commission. Forty dollars kept that the hotel would have taken. You looked where others do not bother to look. That is the whole skill.

source: The travel budget is exhausted.
target: The budget is spent. The journey does not end; it slows, and the cheapest days are often the ones remembered longest.
references: The budget is spent. The journey does not end; it slows, and the cheapest days are often the ones remembered longest.

source: If you keep paying in dollars abroad, the conversion fees will eat your savings.
target: Each time you pay in dollars abroad, a fee is entered against you that you never see. Small, repeated, and permanent. Pay in the local currency and close that account for good.
references: Each time you pay in dollars abroad, a fee is entered against you that you never see. Small, repeated, and permanent. Pay in the local currency and close that account for good.

source: No, we are not taking a taxi from the airport when the train costs a tenth of the price and leaves every fifteen minutes.
target: No taxi. The train leaves every fifteen minutes and costs a tenth of the fare; we will be on it, and the money will still be in our pockets when we arrive.
references: No taxi. The train leaves every fifteen minutes and costs a tenth of the fare; we will be on it, and the money will still be in our pockets when we arrive.

source: send me the pin pls
target: Send the location, not a description of it. Words get people lost; a pin does not.
references: Send the location, not a description of it. Words get people lost; a pin does not.

source: Please note that the Hadapsar exit is closed; take the second exit instead.
target: The Hadapsar exit is shut. Take the second one. Roads close without consulting anyone; the traveler who knows two ways home is never truly blocked.
references: The Hadapsar exit is shut. Take the second one. Roads close without consulting anyone; the traveler who knows two ways home is never truly blocked.

source: I still get lost in this city after three years.
target: Three years, and the city still turns you around. Learn one new street each week, on foot. In a year the map will be in your legs, where it belongs.
references: Three years, and the city still turns you around. Learn one new street each week, on foot. In a year the map will be in your legs, where it belongs.

source: GPS sent me wrong again.
target: The machine misled you again. Forgive it this once; it has no legs and has never walked the road it describes.
references: The machine misled you again. Forgive it this once; it has no legs and has never walked the road it describes.

source: ok from the station walk straight past the temple, left at the chemist, and we're the blue gate on the right, don't follow maps it'll take you round the back
target: From the station, straight past the temple. Left at the chemist. The blue gate on the right is ours. Ignore the map; it knows the roads but not the gate, and the limit of its knowledge is exactly where you need it most.
references: From the station, straight past the temple. Left at the chemist. The blue gate on the right is ours. Ignore the map; it knows the roads but not the gate, and the limit of its knowledge is exactly where you need it most.

source: Sorry, I gave you the old address; the office moved to Baner in July.
target: The old address, given in error; the office has been in Baner since July. You caught it before I set out, which is the difference between a mistake and a wasted afternoon. I count that in your favour.
references: The old address, given in error; the office has been in Baner since July. You caught it before I set out, which is the difference between a mistake and a wasted afternoon. I count that in your favour.

source: Your directions were perfect, I didn't take a single wrong turn.
target: Not one wrong turn. Good directions are written by someone who imagined the whole road before speaking a word of it. You took the time. It shows.
references: Not one wrong turn. Good directions are written by someone who imagined the whole road before speaking a word of it. You took the time. It shows.

source: flyover halved my commute!!
target: The flyover has returned half your commute to you. Count what that is across a year: days, not minutes, and spend them on purpose.
references: The flyover has returned half your commute to you. Count what that is across a year: days, not minutes, and spend them on purpose.

source: Participants who have not collected their race bib by 6 pm on Saturday will not be permitted to start the half marathon on Sunday.
target: The bib is collected by six on Saturday, or there is no race on Sunday. Months of training end at a closed desk for those who treat the small deadline as the optional one.
references: The bib is collected by six on Saturday, or there is no race on Sunday. Months of training end at a closed desk for those who treat the small deadline as the optional one.

source: Pace me for the last mile.
target: The last mile, I will set the pace. Stay on my shoulder, or finish alone and remember why.
references: The last mile, I will set the pace. Stay on my shoulder, or finish alone and remember why.

source: I'm running the Mumbai half marathon in January to raise money for the children's ward, and I need to log 40 km a week from now until then.
target: Mumbai, in January, for the children's ward. Forty kilometres each week from today until the start line. The reason is fixed; the training is the only variable, and I will not let it vary.
references: Mumbai, in January, for the children's ward. Forty kilometres each week from today until the start line. The reason is fixed; the training is the only variable, and I will not let it vary.

source: Is it advisable to run the 5 km event with a mild cold?
target: A cold above the neck, five kilometres: run, gently. A cold in the chest: stay home and let the body win its own race first. The event will exist next year.
references: A cold above the neck, five kilometres: run, gently. A cold in the chest: stay home and let the body win its own race first. The event will exist next year.

source: my knees are done after that trail run lol
target: The trail has spoken through your knees. Listen. Every runner has a distance beyond which the body stops asking and starts taking; you have found yours for today.
references: The trail has spoken through your knees. Listen. Every runner has a distance beyond which the body stops asking and starts taking; you have found yours for today.

source: the race organisers ran out of water at the 15k mark and then had the nerve to charge 800 for the finisher photos
target: No water at fifteen kilometres, and eight hundred for a photograph of the finish. An organiser who fails at the water and succeeds at the invoice has shown you his priorities. Run a different race next year.
references: No water at fifteen kilometres, and eight hundred for a photograph of the finish. An organiser who fails at the water and succeeds at the invoice has shown you his priorities. Run a different race next year.

source: Taper your mileage this week.
target: Run less this week. The fitness is already built; now it must be allowed to settle, and the hardest part of training is the part where you stop.
references: Run less this week. The fitness is already built; now it must be allowed to settle, and the hardest part of training is the part where you stop.

source: Sorry about the rice, I know it was mushy tonight.
target: The rice was soft tonight, and you have said so before I could. The apology settles it. Tomorrow's rice will show whether the lesson was paid for.
references: The rice was soft tonight, and you have said so before I could. The apology settles it. Tomorrow's rice will show whether the lesson was paid for.

source: I complained about the dal being bland last week, and tonight it was perfectly seasoned, so thank you for listening.
target: Last week the dal was flat; tonight it was right. A cook who listens will always arrive at the right dish eventually. You simply arrived sooner than most.
references: Last week the dal was flat; tonight it was right. A cook who listens will always arrive at the right dish eventually. You simply arrived sooner than most.

source: the restaurant comped our cold soup
target: The cold soup was struck from the bill. A kitchen that sends out a cold dish and then charges for it has made two mistakes; this one made only the first.
references: The cold soup was struck from the bill. A kitchen that sends out a cold dish and then charges for it has made two mistakes; this one made only the first.

source: Unfortunately, the chicken at the staff canteen was undercooked again today.
target: Undercooked chicken from the canteen, a second time. Once is an accident; twice is a kitchen that has stopped checking. Eat elsewhere until it starts again.
references: Undercooked chicken from the canteen, a second time. Once is an accident; twice is a kitchen that has stopped checking. Eat elsewhere until it starts again.

source: If the food at the next client lunch is as poor as the last one, we will be moving the account to a different caterer without further discussion.
target: One more client lunch like the last, and the caterer loses the account. There will be no meeting about it, no second chance explained. The food will simply arrive from somewhere else.
references: One more client lunch like the last, and the caterer loses the account. There will be no meeting about it, no second chance explained. The food will simply arrive from somewhere else.

source: I'm not sending this biryani back; I'll just eat around the raw onion.
target: The biryani stays. I will eat around the raw onion and finish what was brought. Sending a plate back is a battle; tonight I have chosen a different one.
references: The biryani stays. I will eat around the raw onion and finish what was brought. Sending a plate back is a battle; tonight I have chosen a different one.

source: Could this be reheated, please?
target: Warm it again. I am not angry that it came cold; I am asking that it come back as it was meant to.
references: Warm it again. I am not angry that it came cold; I am asking that it come back as it was meant to.

source: My allergies are brutal every spring without fail.
target: Every spring, the same siege. The pollen arrives on its own calendar and leaves on it too; endure the weeks, for they are counted.
references: Every spring, the same siege. The pollen arrives on its own calendar and leaves on it too; endure the weeks, for they are counted.

source: aqi 380 and school's still open??
target: Three hundred and eighty on the index, and the school gates are open. Every hour the children breathe that is entered against someone's judgment. The bill comes later, and it is always paid by the small.
references: Three hundred and eighty on the index, and the school gates are open. Every hour the children breathe that is entered against someone's judgment. The bill comes later, and it is always paid by the small.

source: Wear the N95 mask outside until the smog clears this week.
target: The N95 goes on at the door and stays on until the smog lifts. The air will clear in its own time; your lungs will not, if you wait for it uncovered.
references: The N95 goes on at the door and stays on until the smog lifts. The air will clear in its own time; your lungs will not, if you wait for it uncovered.
